tshogs kyi mchod pa mgor/ rje btsun rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs kyi mchod pa mdor bsdus byed par 'dod na zhes pa dang*/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o'i mtha' can/ yang tshes bcu'i mchod chung mgor/ bla ma dam pa dang rnal 'byor ma tha mi dad pa la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pas tshes bcu'i mchod pa zhes dang*/ nyams pa thams cad 'dag gsung gi mtha' can/ sbyin sreg mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod pas zhes pa dang*/ bdag nyid la bsdu'o'i mtha' can/ mar me'i sbyin sreg mgor/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rnal 'byor pa gang zhig mar me'i sbyin sreg zhes pa dang*/ zhal gdams gzhan la phan pa'i blos bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ lam gyi yan lag pra se na dbab pa mgor/ na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ lam gyi yan lag pra se na zhes pa dang*/ pra se na dbab pa'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs mgor// rdo rje phag mo la phyag 'tshal lo// don yod grub pa yi dam du byed pa'i rten gyi gang zag ces pa dang*/ bla ma gnyis kyi brgyud pa'i man ngag yig chung rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgrub thabs mgor/ de nas gnod sbyin mo'i rtog pa bshad par bya ste zhes pa dang*/ tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgrub thabs man ngag tu byas pa rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ padma pa ti'i man ngag mgor/ gnod sbyin mo'i bcud len dang zhes pa dang*/ yid du 'ong ba padma pa ti'i man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ khol po pa ti'i man ngag mgor 'ong nges pa zhes pa dang*/ pra yatstsha dzdza zhes brjod kyi mtha' can/ sman chen po'i bcud len mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lam gyi yan lag sman chen po'i bcud len ni zhes pa dang*/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gdams ngag go i thi'i mtha' can/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por gong sgrub thabs gnyis med rdo rjes mdzad pa man chad nas 'di bar la jo bo nā ro ta pa'i gsung ngag

de'i man ngag thor bu rnams tshang ma zhes pa tsam las so sor ma gsungs kyang thams cad bsdus nas gsungs pa yin no// dbang gi las kyi man ngag mgor// rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyag 'tshal lo// bskyed pa'i rim pa zhes pa nas zin bris chig brgyud du byas pa i thi'i mtha' can/ gsang ba'i gnad lnga zhal shes dang bcas pa'i tho yig sogs man ngag 'thor bu shin tu gsang ba gal che i thi'i mtha' can te 'di rnams rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa yin yang phag mo skor gsum gyi man ngag 'di rnams phyogs gcig tu bya ba'i phyir/ snga ma rnams kyis 'dir bris pa ltar gzhag go /rtsa dbu ma'i man ngag mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// jo bo nā ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i zhes yod pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'khrul 'khor bri bsgom gyi man ngag mgor/ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'chang mtshungs rje btsun bla chen dang*// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor 'di la 'chi med rdo rje lha mo'i sgrub thabs kyang zer gsung*/ kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi bshad thabs kyi man ngag bsdus don bcas mgor/ bla ma rje btsun rin chen lta bu dang*/ zhes yod pa/ kun tu spyod pa'i rgyud kyi gsal byed mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// spang bya'i dri ma ma lus kun spangs shing*// zhes yod pa/ ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// ku ru kulle'i grub thabs la don gnyis te zhes yod pa/ tshogs bdag dmar po'i sgrub thabs sbyin sreg zhal gdams dang bcas pa'i mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// gdams pa 'di rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i le'u zhes yod pa/ dgra nag gi sgrub thabs mgor/ dri med rgyud don ston mdzad bla ma dang*/ zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa mgor/ mi'u thung nag po sprin lta'i mdog

/ces pa dang*/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi bstod pa i thi'i mtha' can/ yang de la bstod pa dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed la bstod pa/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// dngos po kun gyi de nyid chos dbyings kun rtog bral// zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na bstod pa gnyis yod med kyi nges pa ma mdzad kyang gsan yig rgya mtsho dang*/ dbang gi rgyal po gnyis ka nas gnyis kyi gsal kha byung bas gong mar mdzad byang med pa sogs la the tshom ma za zhig phyi ma 'di rtse mo'i zhabs kyis mdzad pa la/ slar yang rje btsun gyis kha skong mdzad pa gzhung tshig gis gsal lo// bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sgrub thabs las sbyor dang bcas pa'i mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i rjes su 'brang ba/ zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro'i sgrub thabs dang bstod pa 'don thabs las kha tshar dang bcas pa mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun sgrol ma zhi khro gnyis// zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma spyi'i sgrub thabs mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// brgyud ldan bla ma'i tshogs dang sgrol ma la// zhes pa dang*/ spyi'i sgrub thabs kyi brjed byang i thi'i mtha' can/ so so'i sgrub thabs mgor/ yi dam lha la phyag 'tshal lo// spyi'i sgrub thabs bzhin bsnyen pa yongs su rdzogs nas sgrub pa dang las sbyor gyi dus kyi rnal 'byor/ zhes yod pa dang*/ mngon par rtogs pa'i brjed byang i thi'i mtha' can/ bstod pa 'don thabs kyi brjed byang mgor/ oṃ swa sti/ thun mtshams su phyag 'tshal nyer gcig pa 'don par 'dod pas/ zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por gong sgrol ma nyin zhi mtshan khro nas 'di'i bar la sgrol ma'i chos skor gsungs pa tsam las ming so sor ma smos kyang yi ge nyung ba'i phyir du phyogs gcig bsdus nas gsung pa yin pas lung bzhugs pa yin no// sgrol ma nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs kyi ṭī ka dang sa bcad mgor/

rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por bla ma la btud nas// zhes yod pa dang*/ rdo rje sgrol ma'i man ngag rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i las tshogs kyi bsdus don mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig ces yod pa/ dbang bskur ba'i sa bcad/ le'u bcu pa dbang bskur ba'i cho ga rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dbang gi cho ga la gnyis te/ zhes pa dang*/ sa bcad do'i mtha' can/ dbang bskur ba'i cho ga mgor/ rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po mtshan nyid lnga dang ldan pa'i bla ma zhes pa dang*/ dbang gi cho ga'i tho tsam phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te bstan pa dbang gi mngon rtogs 'di sa skya pa chen pos mdzad do// dgu pa dbang bskur ba'i man ngag go'i mtha' can/ sgrol ma lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas rigs dang yon tan phun sum tshogs pa zhes dang bshad na mtha' yas par 'gyur mod/ bod skad thad sor bsgyur mi btub lags/ mchan med pa rnams kyi thad sor de skad gsung bar zhu'i mtha' can/ 'di mchims chos seng ge don du mdzad pa yin no// phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad na mo buddhā ya/ bstod pa la don gnyis te/ zhes yod pa/ bstod pa'i rnam bshad gsal ba'i 'od zer mgor/ rje btsun ma 'phags ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal sgrol ma ni zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na 'di rje btsun gyis sgrol bstod la mchan mdzad pa de gang zag rjes ma cig gis dkyus su bcug pa snang ngo gsungs pa de shin tu 'brel che ste mchan dkyus su song tshe tshig gi khrigs gong 'og cung zad 'khrugs pa ltar snang ngo*// sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs yan lag drug pa las tshogs dang bcas pa'i mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i bdag nyid shes rab dngos// zhes yod pa/

gsol 'debs maṇḍal bzhi pa/ na mo gu ra we/ srod dang tho rangs langs par byas nas// zhes yod pa/ rje btsun pa'i rnam thar mnal lam khams pa sbal ston gyis bris pa mgor/ oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma rje btsun chen po grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi zhal nas zhes pa dang*/ rje btsun chen po'i mnal lam bris pa'o'i mtha' can/ rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na 'di khams pa sbal ston gyis bris pa yin na'ang*/ rje btsun gyi gsung ji lta ba bzhin yin pas 'dir bzhag pa yin gsungs/ gsang sngags nang gi lhung bzed brtag pa mgor/ dpal he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo// rin po che'i gzhal yas khang brtag pa la zhes yod pa/ 'di yang rje btsun gyi gsung las ji ltar byung ba bzhin du sna ro'i bandes bris pa yin no// ga ring rgyal po la rtsis bsdur du btang ba'i yi ge mgor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya pa'i brgyud pa ni/ zhes yod pa/ ngan song sbyong rgyud kyi spyi don mgor/ sangs rgyas kun dngos ngo bo nyid// ces yod pa/ sbyong rgyud kyi sa bcad mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba'i rgyud 'di la don bzhi ste/ zhes pa dang*/ 'di ni dpal ldan sa skyar bris kyi mtha' can/ yo ga rdo rje 'byung ba'i yig sna mgor/ chos rnams rang bzhin med gzigs kyang*// zhes pa can/ sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i gzhung so so'i yig sna mgor/ mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten la zhes pa can/ sgrub thabs kun gyi ṭīka chung re dang bsdus don bcas 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu 'dir bzhag 'dug dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i sgrub thabs brgya rtsa'i tho yig mun sel sgron me'i gzhug na sa skya pa chen pos mdzad par bzhed 'dug sgrub thabs spyi'i rnam gzhag mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir 'khor ba la thog ma med ces pa dang sgrub thabs kyi gtad rgya'o i thi'i mtha' can/

rdo rje phur ba'i mngon rtogs dang las byang*/ yang de'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ gsan yig rgya mtshor phur pa'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma/ phur pa'i tho yig rgyun gyi man ngag la sogs pa'i las kha tshar ba 'ga' gsung*/ gong gi tshigs lhug pa 'di rje sa chen gyis mdzad pa yin na'ang 'dir glegs bam kha langs pa'i ched du phur pa'i sgrub skor rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs te bris pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam bzhi pa (ta)pa la kun rig gi cho ga gzhan la phan pa'i 'od zer mgor/ rgyud don gsal bar ston mdzad bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ de'i cho ga bsdus pa gzhan phan nyer mgo mgor/ bcom ldan 'das dpal ngan song thams cad yongs su sbyong ba gzi brjid kyi rgyal po la phyag 'tshal lo// thog mar bdag gi rnal 'byor bstan pa ni/ zhes yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor ro bsregs te sdig pa sbyong ba/ kun rig nas 'byung ba'i phyag len/ zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gsungs pa de thams cad kyang 'dir 'dus so// arga'i cho ga mgor bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// rten gsar pa la zhes yod pa/ rab tu gnas pa'i cho ga don gsal mgor/ bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhabs la spyi bos gus par phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig spros pa kun las rnam grol yang*// zhes yod pa/ bya spyod rigs gsum spyi'i rigs gtad kyi cho ga mgor/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' la phyag 'tshal lo// bya ba dang spyod pa'i rgyud kyi dkyil 'khor du slob ma dbang bskur bar 'dod na zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i rgyud kyi dka' 'grel man ngag don gsal mgor/ rin chen lta bu'i bla ma mchog rnams dang*// zhes yod pa/ mi g.yo ba'i bstod pa rim pa gsum pa 'thad par ldan pa mgor/ dad pas bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// zhes yod pa/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo mgor/

mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs tshigs bcad ma mgor/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang sku gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang zhes yod pa/ 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag na sngon gyi dpe rnying 'ga' la rtse mos mdzad zer ba 'dug pa de dag pa yin no gsung*/ mtshan brjod 'don thabs mgor bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshan yang dag par brjod pa 'don pa'i gdams ngag la gsum zhes yod pa/ a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i sgrub thabs the tshom can du bzhed pa mgor/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob cing zhes pa dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhal mthong shog gi mtha' can/ 'di ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu sing ha shrī zer pa cig gis byas pa snang gsung*/ rje btsun 'phags pa a ra pa tsa na lha lnga'i dbang gi cho ga ye shes snang ba'i sgron ma mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ don yod zhags pa'i cho ga lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mgor na mo buddhā ya/ de nyid don ston bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ de'i maṇḍal gyi cho ga mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// maṇḍal bya ba ni dri zhim po'i chus byugs la zhes pa dang me tog maṇḍal gyi dbus su spungs la gzhag go i thi'i mtha' can/ lha lnga'i bstod pa mgor/ bde gshegs kun las thugs rje mchog gyur pa// zhes pa dang*/ thugs rje'i sgo nas bstod pa dha byang chub sems dpas mdzad pa'o'i mtha' can/ srung 'khor bri tshul tshan pa gnyis mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i srung ba'i 'khor lo la don lnga ste zhes pa dang spyi dang mthun par gda'o'i mtha' can/ lag na rdo rje don kun

gos sngon can yin grub pa'i gzungs kyi lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'dzin dbang dpal ldan bla chen gyi// zhes yod pa/ rnam par 'joms pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka mgor/ don dam ston byed nus pa'i tshogs rnams dang*/ zhes yod pa/ de'i sa bcad mgor dpal rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mdo 'di la gnyis te zhes pa dang phan yon bstan pa'o'i mtha' can 'di gnyis la dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na the tshom can du bzhed yod do// dpung bzang gi mdo 'grel mgor dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa dpung bzang gis zhus pa'i mdo sde 'di la zhes yod pa/ bar 'dir gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po sogs su mkha' lding gi man ngag gsungs kyang dpe rnams na yod pa ni gong sa chen gyi skabs na yod pa dang zhu dag pher ba yod pas logs pa ma bris so// mi g.yo ba gsang ba chen po'i rgyud kyi man ngag mgor/ bgegs rnams 'joms mdzad dngos grub kun stsol ba// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por rtog pa dang po'i rnam 'grel gsungs pa 'di yin no// gtor chen don lnga ma mgor/ bla ma dang ni rkang gnyis gtso// zhes yod pa 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag dang dkon mchog lhun grub gsan yig gnyis ka na rtse mo dang mi mthun pa'i shes byed kyis the tshom can du bzhed do// gtor ma brgya rtsa mgor/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad bskyed pa'i yab// ces yod pa/ gsan yig rgya mtshor byang sems zla ba rgyal mtshan gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i zhes gsung*/ shākya rnams kyi rgyal rabs mgor/ lhar bcas 'gro ba'i gtsug na gang gi gsung*// zhes yod pa/ bod kyi rgyal rabs mgor/ oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ bod kyi rgyal rabs khri bdun ldeng gcig ces yod pa/ rgya bod kyi sde pa'i gyes mdo mgor thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig gang la brten pa yis// zhes pa dang*/

legs pa'i gtam 'di shes par gyis kyi mtha' can/ dus tshod nges par bzung ba'i rtsis yig mgor mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// lo gang la zla ba'i lhag ma yod pa zhes pa can/ gza' skar gyi 'phrod brtag mgor/ 'gro rnams dge dang mi dge bstan pa'i phyir// zhes yod pa/ zhes dgu phrugs kyi yi ge mgor/ 'gro mgon mnyam med ji snyed kun gzigs shing*// zhes pa dang rtse sprod rgod po gshog dang lnga'i mtha' can/ phyag rgya chen po gces btus mgor/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pa'i man ngag phyag rgya chen po gnyis su med pa 'od gsal ba zhes bya ba yod pa sogs man ngag sum cu tham pa bla ma so so'i gdams ngag zab mo rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sbyin sreg mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// rdza gsar pa zhes yod pa/ las dang po pas nyams su blang ba'i rim pa chos spyod rin chen phreng ba mgor/ sku gsum rin chen de'i gsung dri ma med// ces yod pa/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa gsal bar ston pa shlo ka nyi shu pa'i bshad pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo dang*/ don ston don byed bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// zhes yod pa/ spyod 'jug gi bsdus don mgor byang chub sems dpa' chen po gsung gi mnga' bdag ces bya ba yod pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa gnyis kyi dang po'i mgor bla ma sa skya pa chen po dgung lo bcu gnyis bzhes pa'i tshe zhes pa dang*/ nges shes khyad par can thob pa yin no sa māpta mi thi'i mtha' can/ 'di rje btsun gyis mdzad pa yin min brtag gnyis pa'i mgor/ bka' drin can gyi bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ ye shes rdo rje la gnang ba'i nyams dbyangs mgor na mo gu ra we/ dus gsum gyi bla ma thams cad la// zhes pa dang*/ bla med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas myur thob shog gi mtha' can/ khams bde dri ba'i nyams dbyangs mgor/

rje bla ma rnams kyi zhabs la 'dud// ces yod pa dang*/ e ma'o 'gro ba nyon re mongs// zhes pa'i mtha' can yang*/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// zhes pa'i man ngag ye shes rdo rje la gnang ba cig dang*/ bdag dam pa'i lha chos byed pa la// zhes yod pa cig gnas bstod kyi nyams dbyangs mgor dus gsum gyi bla ma dam pa'i zhes pa dang*/ glu mgur gyi rta la bskyon la long*// i thi'i mtha' can/ rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi nyams dbyangs mgor// grong dang gnas gzhi tshong dus gsum// zhes dang rmi lam nyams len brgyad kyi dbyangs i thi'i mtha' can/ gnyen po bsten tshul gyi nyams dbyangs mgor/ sems kyi rang so ma tshugs pas// zhes pa dang*/ sems gnyen po bsten nas blangs pa yin gyi mtha' can/ sems 'dul tshul gyi nyams dbyangs mgor// mngon shes mig bral bdag ni las mang zhing*// zhes dang*/ ting 'dzin skyon can klong du 'gro mi bya'i mtha' can/ sgrub pa nyams su len tshul 'tshal ba brgyad yod pa/ gsang sngags nang pa'i nyams len 'tshal ba bcu yod pa/ rang gis rang la bskul ba mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag ni nyon mongs gyis bzung 'khor ba'i chos la dad// ces yod pa/ nyams dbyangs chen mo mgor na mo gu ru bha drā ya/ yon tan mtha' dag rgyud la sbyor mdzad pa'i// zhes yod pa/ 'di rdo rje 'chang gi dkar chag tu gling ras kyi zur za chen mo la bcos nas gzhan zhig gis byas pa yin nam zhes bdag gi bla ma gsung ngo zhes the tshom can du bzhed/ gso dpyad rgyal po'i dkor mdzod ces grags pa yan lag brgyad pa'i man ngag 'phags pa klu sgrub nas lo tsā ba rin chen bzang po'i bar rim par brgyud de/ bla ma mal lo tsā ba chen po la byung ba'i gdams ngag rnams rje sa chen/ rje btsun chen po/ bla ma dpal chen 'od po rnams kyis gdams ngag 'thor bu mdzad pa rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa dang po 'du ba spyi'i rnam gzhag nas mthar mgo bcos kyi bar gyi sman dpyad 'thor dpyad sogs rten 'brel gyi gdams ngag mang po rnams bzhugs so//

//bzhi pa phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba chen po 'jam mgon sa skya paṇḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhabs kyi gsung rab glegs bam dang po (tha)pa la thub pa'i dgongs pa rab tu gsal ba zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ gzhung lugs legs par bshad pa mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ rol mo'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ blo gsal zhing don du gnyer pa'i skyes bu rnams la ji ltar dri ba'i tshul 'ga' zhig brtsam 'phro la gzhag pa mgor swa sti dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas zhes pa dang*/ de ltar tshig gis nga la dris// zhes pa'i mtha' can/ mkhas pa 'jug pa'i sgo mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ sgra la 'jug pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bden pa brnyes pa 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor// zhes yod pa/ smra sgo'i sa bcad mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// smra ba'i sgo la don gsum ste zhes yod pa/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa'i rnam bshad byis pa la phan pa mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes dang bstan bcos kyi ming de nyid yod pa/ yi ge'i sbyor ba mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bslab pa kun gyi gzhi 'dzin cing*// zhes yod pa/ rnam par gcad bya ji ltar sbyor tshul mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rnam par gcad pa'i yi ge'i tshul cung zad brjod na zhes yod pa/ sngags kyi bklag thabs 'bras bu 'byung ba'i me tog mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rig sngags log par bzlas gyur na/ zhes yod pa/ sgra nye bar bsdus pa'i tshigs su bcad pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bzlas brjod 'dri dang klog sogs la// zhes yod pa/

tshig gi gter mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ sdeb sbyor sna tshogs me tog gi chun po zhes bya ba'i bstan bcos mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i thugs rje la bskul ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bla ma rje btsun chen po'i rnam thar thun mong du grags pa mgor dpal chos kyi rje khams gsum gyi mgon po rje btsun sa skya pa chen po zhes yod pa/ nga brgyad ma rtsa 'grel mgor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sgra pa nga yin zhes dang*/ bshad pa 'di la 'gal ba ci mchis pa// de ni mkhas pa'i tshogs la bzod par gsol gyi mtha' can rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam gnyis pa (da)pa la tshad ma rigs pa'i gter rtsa ba dang 'grel pa gnyis/ dbu ma lugs kyi sems bskyed kyi cho ga mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga rgyas pa zhes yod pa/ de'i lung sbyor mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// byang chub sems las byung ba yi// zhes yod pa/ gnyan phug chung bas mdzad pa'i lū hi pa'i 'bru 'bum 'di dpe snga ma rnams su sa chen gyi skabs na bris 'dug kyang 'dir glegs bam kha langs pa'i ched du bris pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam gsum pa (na)pa la bstan bcos sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la mchod pa brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa mgor bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan blo gros dhīḥlas byung*// zhes yod pa can/ rje btsun chen po la bstod pa mgor/ srid pa'i 'khri shing drwa ba dral mdzad cing*// zhes yod pa/ bi rū pa la bstod pa/ dad pa'i chu las tshig gi me tog 'di// zhes yod pa/ bde mchog brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi skye dang 'jig pa dag

/ces yod pa/ 'di'i bar skabs su kha skong shlo ka gnyis 'di bla ma phyi ma zhig gis mdzad par bsams nas yig chung byas bris yod/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la zhu ba'i phrin yig mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ skyes bu dam pa rnams la spring ba'i yi ge mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// brtse bas legs pa'i lam la sbyor// zhes yod pa/ lung rigs rnam dag dang mthun par 'chad dgos tshul mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// mkhas pa rnams las sde snod mang thos shing*// zhes yod pa/ rtog ldan rgyan po'i dris lan mgor rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul zhes yod pa/ rnel phu ba'i zhus lan mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i don du chos rnams kun// zhes pa dang mdor bsdus pa 'di legs par dgongs kyi mtha' can/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na 'di'i tshab tu rtogs ldan zhig gi dris lan gsungs pa 'di yin nam snyam nas bzhag pa las nges pa ma byung*/ zhang lo tsā ba la gdams pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gsum pa mgor na maḥshrī mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam dag yid kyi chu gtsang las 'khrungs pa'i// zhes yod pa/ bstan pa la dga' ba'i lha rnams la spring ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yang tshigs su bcad pa gong 'og gnyis smras pa zhes pa'i dbu can/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams su bde chen lhun gyis grub pa'i gtsug lag khang du gnyug mar gnas pa'i mkhan slob dge 'dun rnams la gnang ba'i yi ge mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ mi nyag gi rgyal khams na chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi zhes yod pa/ nyi ma la spring ba mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas zhes yod pa/ sho dgon pa 'gro mgon rin chen la spring ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bden par smra ba 'phags pa rgya mtsho'i 'khor// zhes pa dang*/

sho dgon dge 'dun rnams la spring ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams chu gter yon tan padmo'i tshal// zhes pa dang sde dgon yon mchod rnams kyi phyag tu phul gyi mtha' can/ lam zab mo bla ma'i rnal 'byor mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis bskal pa du mar dka' spyad pa// zhes yod pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor gu shi jo 'bum gyi don du mdzad pa mgor na mo gu ru bha drā ya spyir 'o skol rdo rje theg pa'i sgor zhugs pa rnams zhes yod pa/ sgrub pa lung 'bogs mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// sgrub pa lung 'bogs pa'i zhes yod pa/ 'di la mdzad byang med pas sa paṇa yin min brtag sgrub pa lung sbyin mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi rdul dri ma med pa'i zhes yod pa/ rten 'brel lnga'i yi ge mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba lngas zhes yod pa/ lam sbas bshad mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sa bdun pa yan chad ces pa dang*/ yi ge snga mar gsal bas 'dir ma bris so sa māpta'i mtha' can/ grub chen bcu dang phra mo brgyad kyi man ngag phyi nang gsang gsum gyi maṇḍal 'bul chog mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// maṇḍal 'bul bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ aṣṭa'i gzhi bshad snying po don gsal mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// anda rnyil btags zhes yod pa/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i lag tu blang ba'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i// zhes yod pa/ de la dgos pa'i rdo rje gur gyi lung sbyor/ rnam 'joms rgyud kyi bshad pa bdud rtsi spel ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bcu phrag bdun dang lnga phrag gcig /ces yod pa/

lam 'bras khrid kyi dkar chag na mo gu ra we/ mthu stobs dbang phyug gsung gi rgyun// zhes yod pa/ a ra pa tsa na'i sgrub thabs kyi gsal byed mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// 'di'i brgyud pa ni zhes yod pa/ sgrol ma ljang gu'i mngon rtogs mgor rje btsun ma sgrol ma la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun ma sgrub pa'i gang zag gis zhes yod pa/ kag chol gyi rjes gnang mgor na mo gu ru bhyaḥ rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// zhes yod pa/ ba ri ba'i gdams pa thun mong ma yin pa/ yang man ngag bsdus pa gcig dang bcas/ gza' thams cad kyi yum gyi mchod chog mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rigs drug gi mtshan don dang ye shes bsre ba'i bshad pa mgor tshangs pa la brahma zhes pa'i sgras zhes yod pa/ rigs kyi rab dbye'i bshad sbyar mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ sgra sgrub dum bu dgu pa ni dā na zhes pa'i sgra las drangs na zhes pa'i dbu can/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba'i bshad pa mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ bdag med lha mo bco lnga'i bstod pa dri ma med pa'i rgyan gyi 'grel pa mgor dri ma med pa'i rgyan zhes bya ba'i rgya cher 'grel pa zhes yod pa/ zung 'jug gsal ba'i sa bcad mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// slob dpon sgra gcan 'dzin gyis mdzad pa'i zung du 'jug pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi zhes yod pa/ bla ma la thun mong ba'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mgor/ sku yi spyod pa rnam dag pa// zhes yod pa/ thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa mgor/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// ces yod pa/ bod yul la bsngags pa bstod tshig padmo'i phreng ba mgor/ 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// lha mchog rnams kyi gtsug gi nor bu yis// zhes yod pa/ shākya'i rgyal po la gsol ba 'debs pa tshigs su bcad pa bco lnga pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang zhig byang chub shing dbang drung du zhes yod pa/

bde bar gshegs pa khams gsum gyi mgon po la bstod pa tshigs bcad dgu pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag 'phags pa'i gtso dang lha dbang grub pa rig 'dzin gyis// zhes yod pa/ 'jig rten dbang phyug la bstod pa tshigs su bcad pa bcu gcig pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'jig rten dbang phyug lha brgya'i gtsug gis zhabs mchod pa// zhes yod pa/ lha sa'i bde bar gshegs pa rnams la bsngags pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// zla ba kha ba kunda gangs ri'i mdog /ces yod pa/ 'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa'i rnam bshad yi ge nyung ngu zhes bya ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// blo gros gtsug na yon tan nor bu'i 'od gsal zhing*// zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi phyag mtshan ri mo'i yi ger mgor/ sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho// zhes yod pa/ gangs ri'i khrod kyi sgom chen rnams la spring ba mgor/ gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sgom chen mang yod de// zhes yod pa/ bu slob rnams spring ba mgor bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bod yul la bsngags pa zhes byung ba 'di min pa gzhan mi 'dug pas yig skyon yin nam snyam/ bod 'bangs spyi la gdams pa zhes dpe dngos la 'dug bka' gdams do kor ba'i zhu ba/ do kor ba'i zhus lan mgor bla ma dang mgon po 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// so sor thar pa 'dul ba bzhin// zhes yod pa/ mu stegs kyi ston pa 'phrog byed dga' bo la sogs pa drug btul ba'i tshe sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ rgya mtsho'i gos can zhes pa'i dbu can/ yon tan sgrogs pa'i tshal la bstod pa mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// do shal phreng ba sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*// zhes yod pa/

ba gor zhes bya ba'i sgra las bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ rta nag ri khud kyi rnga bo che la bsngags pa mgor/ lha dang lha dbang klu dbang mi yi gtso// zhes yod pa/ don mo ri pa'i gtsug lag khang du rje btsun gyi ri mo mdzad dus kyi tshigs bcad gnyis/ dpal gdong bzhi pa'i mgon po la bstod pa mgor na mo gu ra we dang*/ tshig de nyid yod pa/ theg chen lam gyi rnam gzhag mdor bsdus mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// thub pas chos rnams gang gsungs pa// zhes yod pa/ zhen pa bzhi bral gyi gdams pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// spyir dal 'byor gyi lus thob ces yod pa/ snang ba mtha' yas kyi sgom don mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bzang spyod nas 'byung ba'i zhes yod pa/ 'chi kha ma'i gdams ngag ngo mtshar can mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dang po dkon mchog gsum skyabs 'gro// zhes yod pa/ 'phags pa sdud pa sogs shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'don thabs mgor rje btsun bla ma thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa sdud pa la sogs pa shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mdo 'don par 'dod na zhes bya ba yod pa/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don thabs na mo mañdzu shrī ye/ phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don pa'i man ngag ni zhes yod pa/ spyod pa rnam dag gi tshigs su bcad pa bcu gnyis pa mgor spyod pa rnam par dag pa zhes yod pa/ sems kyi gnas lugs rnal du mtshon par byed pa'i man ngag tshigs su bcad pa brgyad pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ chags lo'i zhu ba mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ sdom pa gsum ldan rig pa'i gnas lnga thugs su chud pa zhes yod pa/ de'i zhus lan mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bde byed chur nyal rang byung me tog mda'// zhes yod pa/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen la spring ba mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ dpal sa skya'i dgon pa nas zhes yod pa/

bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas dge ba'i bshes gnyen bsgrub pa rtse gcig tu mdzad cing thugs dgongs rnam par dag zhes yod pa/ ston pa blo gros rab gsal gyi drin las mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ snye mo sgom chen gyi dris lan mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sa skya paṇḍi tas dad pa dang 'dun pa dang ldan zhing zhes yod pa/ rnal 'byor pa phru ma'i dris lan mgor rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi rnam 'phrul zhes yod pa/ bsngo ba yon bshad mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba dgra rgyal chos kyi rgyal po yi// zhes yod pa/ bde mchog lhan skyes kyi byin rlabs ras pa shes rab 'od kyi don du mdzad pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// bde mchog 'khor lo lhan cig skyes pa yi// zhes yod pa/ rlung gi rten 'brel mgor/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs pad la btud de/ rlung gi rten 'brel zhes yod pa/ mnal lam tshigs bcad ma mgor/ skye ba skye ba med pa'i tshul rtogs kyang*// zhes yod pa/ dbang gi rgyal po'i sbyin sreg mgor gsum pa mjug gi sbyin sreg bya ba'i zhes yod pa/ sme brtsegs kyi sgrub thabs mgor na mo gu ru bhyaḥ khro bo stobs po che bsgrub par 'dod pas zhes bya ba yod pa/ lus kyi zag pa sbyin pa gtong ba'i gzungs mgor dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gong gi ming de nyid dang ba ri lo tsā bas bsgyur ba/ rang gis rang la gros 'debs mgor/ yon tan rin chen dpal gyis lham me ba// zhes yod pa/ dug bcos mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sbyor ba dang po 'dis zhes pa dang*/ yang dug glo bur ba zhes pa gnyis/ sgra'i bstan bcos mkhas pa'i kha rgyan mgor oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ dang*/

tshig de nyid yod pa/ legs bshad 'phrul gyi drwa ba mgor bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// thams cad mkhyen pas bdag rgyud byin gyis brlabs zhes bya ba yod pa 'di the tshom can du bzhed pa yin no// zhar las sa skya paṇḍi ta'i rnam thar mkhas pa zhang rgyal ba dpal gyis mdzad pa'ang bris yod/ 'dir gsan yig na yod pa'i phyi mo ma rnyed pa ni brtag gnyis kyi sa bcad sna bsring ba/ thub pa'i bstod pa lhug pa/ gur ston zhus lan/ bka' gdams pa nam mkha' 'bum gyi dris lan mdor bsdus/ yan lag bdun ldan gyi rtsa ba rnams so// //lnga pa khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i zhal snga nas kyi gsung rab glegs bam dang po (pa)pa la shes bya rab tu gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ lam 'bras brgyud pa'i phyag mchod mi 'phrogs ma/ rgyud 'grel gyi brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// thabs dang shes rab kun tu mnyam sbyor zhing*// zhes yod pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa ku mu ti dang bcas pa'i gsol 'debs gsungs pa 'di yin no// ba ri ba'i chos skor gyi brgyud 'debs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// zhes yod pa/ 'jigs byed brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan sangs rgyas kun rang bzhin// zhes yod pa/ bla ma brgyud pa'i mtshan 'bum saṃ skṛ ta'i skad can/ bla ma dam pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab byed spel ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo// dpal mchog sangs rgyas kun bdag nyid// ces yod pa/ yang gsol ba 'debs pa'i rab byed sku'i spyod pa la spel ba/ bla ma spyi'i bstod pa mu tig phreng ba mjug tu tshig de nyid yod pa/

chos rje pa la bstod pa gnyis mgor na maḥshrī māṃ pa ra ma gu ru tsa ra ṇaṃ ka ma la sya banda naṃ ka ro mi/ blo chen ldan pa zhes dang*/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi sngon du byang chub brnyes gyur kyang*// zhes yod pa/ chos spyod bcu pa cung zad rgyas par spel ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las srid dang rnam grol ba'i// zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog lhun grub gsan yig na gsol 'debs yan lag bdun pa gsungs pa 'di yin nam snyam/ chos spyod yan lag bcu pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyogs dus kun na bzhugs pa yi// zhes yod pa/ chos rje pa la bstod pa ri bo rtse lngar sbyar ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis tshogs ni rdzogs gyur cing*// zhes yod pa/ dkon mchog gsum la bstod pa mgor/ bsod nams chu gter dbus su legs 'khrungs shing*// zhes yod pa/ chos rje pa'i mtshan la spel ba'i bstod pa gnyis mgor 'gro kun gang la zhes pa dang*/ bde legs 'byung gnas zhes yod pa/ yang chos rje pa la bstod pa bzhi gang gi thugs zhes pa dang*/ bsod nams gser gyi zhes pa dang*/ mkhas pa'i tshogs kun zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i snying po zhes yod pa/ thogs med sku mched sogs la bstod pa tshul khrims lhun po zhes yod pa/ yang chos rje pa la bstod pa gnyis mgor gdong bzhi thor tshugs zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i chu 'dzin zhes yod pa/ thos pa rgya mtsho ma/ mchog brgyad kyi bstod pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhung lugs mi 'dra'i chu bo zhes yod pa/ bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa gang drin ma'i 'bru 'grel/ bla ma la maṇḍal 'bul zhing gsol ba 'debs pa sho dgon gyi slob dpon sbyong nga ba'i don du mdzad pa/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor la'o shu'i don du mdzad pa/

bla ma la thun mong ma yin pa'i sgo nas gsol ba 'debs pa phyogs bcu dus gsum ma dge slong gnas brtan byang chub bzang po'i don du mdzad pa/ chos rje pa'i rnam thar bsdus pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi rang bzhin kun nas rnam dag ces yod pa/ chos rje pa la rnam thar gyi sgo nas bstod pa me tog phreng ba mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhes yod pa/ lam 'bras lam skor sogs kyi gsan yig mgor/ sangs rgyas kun dngos bla ma la// zhes yod pa/ bkra shis rgyal mtshan gyis zhus nas mtshal mdor bsdebs pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i brtag pa gnyis pa'i bsdus pa'i don mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyud kyi mngon rtogs ljon chung mgor phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes yod pa/ zhar byung maṅga la yab yum la gnang ba'i bkra shis/ ji big yab yum la gnang ba'i bkra shis/ dpon mo chen mo la gnang ba'i bkra shis gsum yang bris 'dug brtag gnyis kyi 'grel pa dag ldan chung ba mgor dpal kye'i rdo rje'i rgyud 'di 'chad par byed pa la zhes yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i spyi don gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi le'u'i 'brel mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud kyi rgyal po'i bsdus don mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yig brgya bzla ba'i man ngag mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ bla ma la maṇḍal dbul zhing gsol ba gdab pa'i man ngag mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rtsa ba'i bla ma la zhes yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i mngon par rtogs pa yid bzhin nor bu mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ kye'i rdo rje'i sgrub thabs srung 'khor dang bcas pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// mnyam sbyor bde chen rtag pa'i skya// zhes yod pa/

gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por yig brgya bzla ba'i tshul gnyis gsungs pa gcig 'di'i mgo na yod pa bgrang ba yin/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug chung mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi pa dang zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi drug gi mi 'dra ba'i khyad par gsungs pa'ang 'di yin no// bsnyen pa'i grangs tshad kyi zhus lan mgor dpal ldan bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dad pas dri ba byed pa gang yin pa// zhes yod pa/ dam tshig gsum gyi glu'i rjes la bya ba'i smon lam mgor tshig de nyid kyi phyed yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bdag 'jug dpal 'byung ma gsungs pa'ang 'di yin/ dbang gong ma gsum gyi lag len gyi rim pa tshigs bcad ma/ bdag 'jug gi cho ga snying po gsal ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// khyab bdag gnyis med bde chen rtag pa'i sku// zhes yod pa/ lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa blang ba'i lag len mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// lam dus kyi dbang rgyas pa zhes yod pa/ rgya mtshor go go can gyi don du mdzad pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ kye'i rdo rje'i lus dkyil gyi sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'gro ba'i lus sems gdod ma nas// zhes yod pa/ dpal kye rdo rje'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i bum pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i lung sbyor rdo rje gur nas phyung ba/ tshogs 'khor bsdus pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho'i dpal las 'khrungs gyur pa'i// zhes yod pa/ bdud rtsi 'byung ba mgor bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bdud rtsi lnga dang zhes yod pa/

dpal rdo rje bdag med ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rdo rje bdag med ma'i bstod pa rnam dag gi phreng ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dag pa gsum gyi khrid yig mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// lam gyi sngon du 'gro ba zhes yod pa/ tshogs sbyor gyi mngon rtogs

dbang gsum pa'i lam yang zer mgor tshig snga ma de nyid yod pa/ 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'pho ba'i rnal 'byor sgom par zhes yod pa/ khro bcu'i bstod bskul mgor dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mkha' dbyings dag pa'i klong dkyil du// zhes yod pa/ seng ge mtha'i zhus lan rnam par nges pa mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gi kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtsho yi// zhes yod pa/ dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris lan tshigs bcad ma mgor rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba yod pa/ dus 'khor thugs dkyil gyi mngon rtogs mgor na mo gu ru kā la tsakrā ya zhes yod pa/ bde mchog nag po pa'i dbang gi sdom tshigs bcad ma mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs padma'i lte bar bzhugs// zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyi snying po zhes bya ba'i mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mchod pa'i cho ga kun tu bzang po'i mchod sprin zhes bya ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg gi sdom tshigs bcad ma mgor na maḥshrī tsakra saṃ ba ra/ nyon mongs bud shing kun bsregs shing*// zhes yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga rgyas pa mgor dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs nyung zhing gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam gnyis pa (pha)pa la dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa'i thabs rim pa gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa mgor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/

gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por ngag 'don gsungs pa 'di yin/ bde mchog gi rgyun bshags dpal nā ro pa las brgyud de 'ongs pa mgor bla ma dang bde mchog la phyag 'tshal rgya skad du yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyi bstod bskul mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// hūm̐ nga ni sku gsum mnyam sbyor zhing*// zhes yod pa/ dril bu pa'i dbang gi bya ba bsdus pa tshigs bcad ma mgor/ sku gsum ye shes lnga yi dngos// zhes yod pa/ lus dkyil gyi bdag 'jug mgor dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i rim pa lnga pa'i man ngag mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs jo sras phag mchu'i don du mdzad pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal bde mchog lhan cig skyes pa zhes yod pa/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'di kha che rin chen rdo rjes mdzad pa la tshig rkang ma mnyam pa la sogs pa rnams kyi zhus dag dang kha skong mdzad pa yin/ yang jim gyim dang go go can la gnang ba'i bkra shis tshigs bcad mgor/ bla ma dang dkon mchog ces pa dang bla ma la na maḥzhes yod pa/ phag mo lha so bdun ma'i mngon rtogs mgor rje btsun ma rdo rje phag mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ na ro mkha' spyod gyi mngon rtogs mgor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs mgor rdo rje rnal 'byor ma mkha' spyod ma bsgom par 'dod pa zhes yod pa/

de'i tshogs 'khor mgor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga zhes yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg mgor dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa/ dpal rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i sindhu ra'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i sdig sbyong gi cho ga mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das za byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i sgo nas zhes yod pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs sgyu 'phrul rnam par rol pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ma hā mā yā bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i tshogs kyi 'khor lo'i cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i sgrub thabs mgor rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig gi lha mo'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// phyag 'tshal nyi shu rtsa gcig pa'i lha mo bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ gur gyi rdo rje sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa thang ngo ta'i don du mdzad pa yin/ bcom ldan 'das ma sgrol ma'i lus kyi dkyil 'khor bsgom pa'i rim pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ slob dpon thams cad mkhyen pa'i bshes gnyen gyis mdzad pa'i 'jigs pa brgyad skyob kyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor ming de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du byas pa/ 'di 'phags pas mdzad pa min yang kha che'i paṇḍi ta ta thā ga ta bha dra dang 'phags pas rgya'i yul cong to mkhar du bsgyur ba yin/ gnas kyi dbang phyug ma'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// srid gsum 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las sgrol ma// zhes yod pa/

gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por au ḍyan gyi sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs gsungs pa'ang de nyid yin no// 'phags pa mkha' 'gro ma rdo rje gur gyi rjes su 'brang ba'i sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ phyag drug sgrol ma'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'di sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rjes su 'brang ba yin/ sgrol ma lha bcu bdun ma'i dbang chog mgor rje btsun ma sgrol ma'i dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba'i cho ga zhes yod pa/ mdor byas kyi sa bcad mgor 'di la gnyis te zhes yod pa/ gsang 'dus mi bskyod pa'i dbang chog mgor dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi cho ga dbang rab tu gsal ba zhes yod pa/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyi rnam thar dang brgyud pa'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sngon byung ba rgya gar lho phyogs kyi yul zhes yod pa/ dpal gsang ba 'dus pa lha bcu dgu'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dgra nag po'i sgrub pa'i thabs bsdus pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i mngon rtogs mgor dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi mngon par rtogs pa zhes yod pa tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ yang dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag drug pa'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa a rog che'i don du mdzad pa/ dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ phyag gnyis pa'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// ya mānta ka bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ 'jigs byed kyi bdag 'jug mgor dpal chen po'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga zhes yod pa/ de'i sbyin sreg mgor dpal chen po'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga zhes yod pa/

zhe dgu ma'i sgrub thabs mgor 'jam dpal zhi khro rnam par rol pa'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa/ rab gnas saṃ gha mi tra'i don du mdzad pa mgor/ sangs rgyas thams cad gcig bsdus pa'i// zhes yod pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa lha bcu gsum ma yin/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lha lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po'i sgrub thabs 'jigs pa med pa rnam par rol pa mgor tshig de nyid yod cing tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa/ dpal gshin rje gshed dmar po lhan skyes kyi sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba'i rnam par bshad pa dam tshig rab tu gsal ba mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ bla ma lnga bcu pa'i bsdus don mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ gang gi bskal pa du mar rnyed dka' ba'i// zhes yod pa/ sbyong rgyud nas gsungs pa'i tshe dpag med kyi sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpag yas bsod nams ye shes tshogs las nyer bsgrubs pas// zhes yod pa/ mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid dang bsod nams gser gyi sa gzhi zhes yod pa/ tshe dpag med kyi bstod pa padmo'i phreng ba mgor bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa zhes yod pa/ 'od dpag med kyi bsgom thabs mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pa'i sgo nas zhes yod pa/ mi 'khrugs pa'i sbyin sreg mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mtshungs med bla ma chos rje rin po che dang zhes yod pa/ phyag na rdo rje'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dang gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal phyag na rdo rje bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/

rnam 'joms kyi sgrub thabs bya ba bsrung sbyin sreg dang bcas pa mgor rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom par zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// stan bde ba la zhes yod pa/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs rdo rje khye'u 'dren gyi don du sbyar ba/ thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa rgya yul du sbyar ba/ seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs sgang rar sbyar ba/ rta mgrin khyung gshog can gyi sgrub thabs tre'i sa char bkod pa/ byams pa'i chos skor yan lag dang bcas pa mgor rje btsun bla ma dam pa dang 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes yod pa/ mi g.yo ba sngon po'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dang rje btsun mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo// rje btsun mi g.yo ba zhes yod pa/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod cing phyag bzhi pa 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ de'i bstod pa mgor/ gang gi drin gyis bde 'gro'i 'byor pa dang*/ zhes yod pa/ rje btsun ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs stong mchod dang bcas pa mgor rje btsun ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs bcom ldan 'das ma zhes yod pa/ gdugs dkar bsgom thabs gzungs bklag thabs dang bcas pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bor phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/

ri khrod lo ma can sgrub thabs gzungs cho ga dang bcas pa mgor rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ ri khrod ma'i sgrub thabs chos rje sa skya pa'i man ngag yi ger bkod pa'o'i mtha' can/ de'i bstod pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// zhes yod pa/ tsunda'i sgrub thabs rgyud las byung ba'i rim pa mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ srung ba lnga'i dbang chog gi skor gtor ma/ byur bsal/ dug dbyung*/ dbang chog gi sdom/ dbang bskur ba dngos te de rnams rgyas pa 'og glegs bam ba pa'i nang na bzhugs kyang 'di nyid kyi sngags rnams la 'dra min mang po byung ba phyi mo mang po la gtugs nas zhus dag nan cher byas tshe 'di ltar byung la/ 'og ma ni bka' dang bstun pa'i zhu dag bgyis pa yin pas gang dag dpyad par bya'o// phyogs bcu'i mun pa rnam par sel ba'i bkra shis dang*/ zhar byung rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa'i rnam par bshad pa gsung rab gsal ba'i rgyan zhes bya ba 'phags pa'i dngos slob shes rab gzhon nus mdzad pa rnams bzhugs so// //glegs bam gsum pa (ba)pa la 'phags ma 'od zer can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs tshigs bcad ma mgor ming de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ mya ngan med pa'i 'od zer can gyi sgrub thabs bstod pa dang bcas pa'i mgor lha mo 'od zer can sgrub pa'i thabs rje btsun ma 'od zer can la phyag 'tshal lo// phrin las 'od kyis zhes yod pa/ yang de'i sgrub thabs bstod pa bcas mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags ma 'od zer can sgrub par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ 'di skad gnyis smra ba du lag gi ngor mdzad pa'o/ lha mo 'od zer can gyi sbyin sreg gi cho ga mgor tshig de nyid yod cing 'di dang gong gi sgrub thabs gnyis lo tsā ba saṃ gha'i don du mdzad pa yin/

de'i bstod pa rgyas pa mgor bcom ldan 'das 'od zer can ma'i bstod pa zhes yod pa/ spyan ma'i sgrub pa'i thabs mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ gza' yum gyi sgrub thabs mgor rje btsun ma gza' thams cad kyi yum bsgom par 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ zhar la sngags kyi dag byed cig kyang ma dpe na byung ba bzhin bris yod/ 'dod pa'i lha rnams la bstod pa mgor/ rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las skyes pa'i sras// zhes yod pa/ rig ma bcu drug gi mchod pa'i tshig tshan pa gnyis kyi mgor na mo gu ru badzra dha rā ya/ rdo rje lha mo pi wang ma// zhes yod pa dang*/ na mo badzra satwā ya/ hūm̐ gi yi ge las byung dpal lha mo// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por che brjod dang mchod gar gsungs pa de yin/ srung ba lnga'i sdom ring thung gnyis kyi mgor/ rigs kyi khro bo'i nga rgyal gyis// zhes dang rje btsun ma rig pa'i rgyal mo lnga la phyag 'tshal lo// de nas rig sngags 'chang ba zhes yod pa/ de'i mtshams gcod mgor gnas dang yo byad byin phab nas zhes yod pa/ de'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa mgor srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes yod pa/ de'i sgrub thabs rgyas pa mgor gong gi tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i bstod pa mgor srung ba lnga'i lha mo la bstod pa zhes yod pa/ yang de'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs la bstod pa mgor srung ba lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi bstod pa zhes yod pa/ 'di slob dpon shānti pas mdzad pa la 'phags pas kha skong mdzad gsung*/ phyogs kyi gtor ma mgor de nas phyogs kyi gtor ma gtang ba'i phyir zhes yod pa/ gza' skar gyi gtor ma mgor gza' dang rgyu skar la mchod cing gtor ma phul nas 'di skad ces yod pa/ byur bsal ba de nas dbang bskur ba'i sngon du byur bsal ba'i phyir zhes yod pa/ dug dbyung ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gzi brjid dang*// zhes yod pa/

rgyal bar byed pa mgor na mo buddhā ya zhes yod pa/ dbang bskur ba dngos mgor de nas yon gyi bdag pos maṇḍal phul la zhes yod pa/ 'di yan dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dang dbang gi rgyal po gnyis kar gza' skar gyi gtor ma sogs gsungs pas sogs khongs su bsdus par nges shing phyi mo mang po na yang dpe tshan gcig tu byas 'dug dbang bskur ba'i gzungs phyi ma mgor tadya thā oṃ gi ri gi ri zhes yod pa/ bden pa'i stobs brjod pa mgor bden pa dang bden pa'i mchog gang gis zhes yod pa/ shis pa brjod pa mgor nad pa'i zas dang skom dang zhes yod pa ste 'di gnyis gong ma'i khar sa bcad bcu bzhi pa dang bco lnga pa 'grigs kyang dpe rgyun gcig las ma byung bas dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig na thus min slar dpyad/ rgyud sde'i dkar chag mgor na mo gu ru bhyaḥn maḥshrī bhaṭṭā ra ka badzra dha rā ya zhes yod pa/ mgon po'i sgrub yig mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid bla ma dang*// zhes yod pa/ bdud rtsi lnga mchod mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi// zhes yod pa/ mgon po'i bstod pa mgor na mo gu ru bhyaḥn maḥshrī ma hā kā lā ya/ hūm̐ gang gi thugs ni dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por bstod pa gnyis gsungs kyang 'di las ma byung bas yig skyon yin nam brtag lcam dral gyi gtor chog mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal rdo rje nag po chen po dang zhes yod pa jim gyim la phul ba gsungs pa 'di yin/ bshags pa mgor dpal rdo rje nag po chen po lcam dral zhes yod pa/ gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa mgor dpal gdong bzhi pa'i bstod pa zhes yod pa/ dzambha la ser po'i sgrub thabs mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'phags pa dzambha la bsgom par zhes yod pa/

phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma mgor dpal rdo rje 'dzin pa la phyag 'tshal lo// shar phyogs su lha thams cad pa'i gtor ma zhes pa nas byang phyogs su bya ba gnod sbyin thams cad pa'i gtor ma'i cho ga rdzogs so'i mtha' can/ sa skya pa'i nyin zhag phrugs gcig la thugs dam du mdzad pa'i gtor ma'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// chos rje sa skya pa yab sras kyis nyin zhag phrugs gcig la zhes yod pa/ cha gsum gtor ma 'bring po mgor bgegs gtor ni/ bsang ba nas zhes yod pa/ klu gtor mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// klu gtor gtang bar 'dod pas zhes yod pa/ chu gtor gtang ba'i rim pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyu dang tshegs chung zhing phan yon dang zhes yod pa/ bstod dbyangs rgya mtsho snyan ngag rin po che'i rgyan rnam par bkra ba mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya dang tshig snga ma de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por chos rje sa paṇa la bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa'i bstod pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshems mche ba mthong tshe bstod pa yin/ 'jam dpal la mtshan don gyi sgo nas bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ skyabs mchog sangs rgyas kun gyi dngos// zhes yod pa tshigs su bcad pa nyi shu lnga yod/ 'jam dpal la nye bar bsngags pa me tog gi phreng ba mgor na mo gu ru mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ shes bya kun mkhyen chos kyi rgya mtsho zhes yod pa/ 'jam dbyangs la ri bo rtse lngar bstod pa nor bu'i phreng ba mgor na mo mañdzu nā thā ya/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes rgya mtshor 'khrungs// zhes yod pa/ phyag mtshan ri mo'i bstod tshig la spel ba mgor 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bde gshegs thub pas sa gsum snyan par bsgrags// zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo la bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/

rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes las grub pas// zhes yod pa/ phyag 'tshal du phyin pa'i tshe ri bo rtse lnga'i rigs so so dang mthun par bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ byams pa'i lte ba rab tu brtan zhing zhes yod pa/ ā nanda kīrti'i don du dpa' bo'i 'khor lo bris pa mgor pañtsa parba ta bi kri ḍā zhes yod pa/ 'jam dpal la bstod pa mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ rnam pa sna tshogs lo 'dab kyis bkra zhes yod pa/ skyid grong gi 'phags pa wa ti la mnal lam du bstod pa mgor na maḥshrī lo ke shwa rā ya 'phags pa 'jig rten mgon po zhes yod pa/ byams pa mgon po la bstod pa mgor/ byams pa'i thugs kyis byang chub thugs bskyed nas// zhes yod pa/ gnas brtan bcu drug la bstod pa mgor/ dgra bcom blo mchog dbang dul ba// zhes yod pa/ yan lag bcu pa mgor/ dus gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du/ zhes yod pa/ yan lag bdun pa phyag mchod sdig bshags bsngo ba dang bcas pa'i tshigs bcad mgor/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa'i sku gsung thugs// zhes yod pa/ sems bskyed kyi cho ga bsdus pa mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// 'o nyid cag byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i zhes yod pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bsngo ba dang bcas pa 'bring du bstan pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// spyir bstan pa'i gzhi skyabs su 'gro ba yin zhes yod pa/ yang de gsum bsdus pa yul skyong mgon po dpal bzang gi don du mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag bo lod kyi don du mdzad pa/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed dbang bskur gyi bslab bya rgyal po a rog che la phul ba/ rgyal po la gdams pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ de'i bsdus don mgor mkhyen rab kyi dbang phyug 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa zhes yod pa/ theg pa chen po gsol ba zhes bya ba yi ge'i ma mo la spel ba'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/

de'i bsdus don mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya theg pa chen po gsal ba la don gsum zhes yod pa/ las 'bras gsal ba'i me long tshigs su bcad pa bzhi bcu pa mgor ming de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la gtam du bya ba nor bu'i phreng ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu maṅgal la gtam du bya ba bkra shis kyi phreng ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu no mo gan la spring ba'i rab tu byed pa tshigs su bcad pa brgya rtsa brgyad pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal po ho ko'i don du mdzad pa'i theg pa che chung gi chos kyi rnam gzhag mgor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir rgyal po ho ko'i don du zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu de gus bho ga la gdams pa bdud rtsi'i 'byung gnas mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rgyal bu de mur bho ga la gdams pa zla ba'i 'od zer mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dpon mo punda ri'i don du mdzad pa sgrub pa'i rim pa rab tu gsal ba mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag la phyi dang nang gi zhes yod pa/ rgyal sras jim gyim la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa 'phags pas zhes yod pa/ yang jim gyim la spring ba gnyis kyi mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// rang bzhin sangs rgyas rin chen te// zhes pa dang*/ brtse ba'i dbang phyug thams cad mkhyen pa zhes yod pa/ a tsa ra la spring ba mgor/ mi gang dal ba 'byor pa thob gyur cing*// zhes yod pa/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen ldong ston gyi don du spring ba'i yi ge mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs kun 'byung na// zhes yod pa/ ye shes 'bum la gdams pa bdud rtsi'i thig le mgor bstan bcos kyi ming de nyid yod pa/ rigs par smra ba grags bzang la spring ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/

bden pa gnyis rnam par nges pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ zab mo snang ba zhes bya ba'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ phyag rgya chen po nyams su len pa'i man ngag mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa nyid// ces yod pa/ de'i khrid yan lag bdun ldan mgor phyag rgya chen po nyams su blang ba'i man ngag yan lag bdun pa zhes yod pa/ yan lag bdun gyi gtam mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dam chos pad dkar gyi tshig don la gzhan gyi log par rtog pa dgag pa mgor sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// dam pa'i chos padma dkar po las byung ba'i gsung rab kyi zhes yod pa/ bu mo rin chen gyis zhus pa'i mdo'i don yang dag par bsdus pa mgor theg pa chen po'i man ngag yang dag par bsdus pa zhes yod pa/ snying po'i sdom/ thabs la mkhas pa'i sdom/ ting nge 'dzin gyi sdom/ byang chub sems dpa'i sa'i sdom/ sangs rgyas kyi sa'i sdom ste zab mo'i mdo lngar grags pa'i sdom rnams kyi mgor so so'i tshig de rnams yod pa/ theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bstan bcos kyi bsdus don mgor/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs khams dang byang chub dang*// zhes yod pa/ skyo ba'i gtam mgor na mo gu ru mañdzu nā thā ya/ thugs kyi bang mdzod yon tan nor bus gtams// zhes yod pa/ ngan pa'i spyod tshul la khrel ba'i gtam mgor 'dir smras pa/ snyigs ma'i dus 'dir snyigs ma'i ngang tshul can// zhes yod pa/ theg pa'i rnam par dbye ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ bsam gtan shes rab kyi drin lan mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer can// zhes yod pa/ ka sogs sum cu la spel ba'i tshigs bcad mgor na mo mañdzu gho ṣā ya/ ka la piṅga'i dbyangs ltar snyan gsung gis// zhes yod pa/ ldan yul du skyes pa'i ston pa brtson 'grus kyi drin las mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// 'dir dris pa'i lan cung zad gdab par bya ste zhes yod pa/

byang chub lam gyi snying po bsgom pa'i rim pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dran pa gso thabs mgor/ gang gi bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs pas// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por lta ba ston pa'i tshigs bcad gsungs pa 'di 'dra/ dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge tshogs dpag med rin chen las bsgrubs shing*// zhes yod pa/ tsha rong ba la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis med thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor rgya che zhing*// zhes yod pa/ sdom brtson cig la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// chos dbyings rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs shing*// zhes yod pa/ zab mo nyams su len tshul mdor bsdus mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// rtag tu 'chi ba bsam par bya// zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// kun nas brtse ba'i thugs mnga' ba// zhes yod pa/ yang de la spring ba mgor/ ye shes dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// zhes yod pa/ yi gyang jus glegs bam bsgrubs pa la bsngags pa mgor/ na mo gu ru ratna tra yā ya/ dpal kun gyi ni 'byung gnas te// zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' la gnang ba'i bka' yig mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// zag pa med dbyings nam mkha'i khams// zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu algo la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bsod nams rgya mtsho'i dbus su legs 'khrungs pa// zhes yod pa/ rin chen pakṣi la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor rab rgyas shing*// zhes yod pa/ bram ze'i paṇḍi ta lakṣ+mī ka ra la spring ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dge slong blo gros kyi ming dang ldan pa zhes yod pa/

shong ston lo tsā ba la spring ba bla ma 'phags pas zhes yod pa/ rwa dpon la spring ba mgor// gzhung lugs brgya phrag du ma'i chu klung dang*// zhes yod pa/ 'phags pa ral gri la spring ba mgor/ mkha' dbyings dag pa skye dgu'i sgron me'i dpal// zhes yod pa/ spyi bo lhas pa bshes gnyen rin chen la bskur ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gdod nas nyer zhi zhi ba'i lam gyis zhes yod pa// chag lo tsā ba/ dbus gtsang gi mtshan nyid pa spyi/ dbus kyi bka' gdams pa spyi/ stag lung pa/ dbus kyi sgom chen pa spyi rnams la rim pa bzhin du ma chags lo bdag ces pa dang*/ dmigs med thugs rje'i zhes pa dang*/ ji bzhin gzigs pas zhes pa dang*/ srid dang zhi ba'i zhes pa dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang zhes pa rnams kyi dbu can/ rgyal bu ji big de mur la spring ba gsum gyi mgor ye shes dkyil 'khor zhes pa dang*/ spros pa med pa'i zhes pa dang*/ mtshan dpe'i dpal zhes bya ba rnams rim pas yod pa/ dpon mo du gal dur mi la bskur ba gnyis kyi mgor dpal ldan yon tan zhes pa dang*/ chos kyi dbyings las zhes yod pa/ rgyal bu jim gyim/ ho ko grags bzang*/ ston gzhon rnams la spring ba'i mgor 'dir smras pa/ deng sang 'di na zhes pa dang*/ stobs sogs yon tan zhes pa dang*/ mdangs dang dri ro zhes pa dang*/ blo che rlom che zhes bya ba rnams rim pas yod pa/ gos dar lnga stong dang dgu brgya bzhi bcu phul ba'i dus kyi mchod brjod dang bsngo ba mgor/ chos kyi dbyings kyi mkha' las mngon 'phags shing*// zhes yod pa/ tshe dpag med la bstod pa mgor/ sna tshogs 'dab rgyas chu skyes zhes bya ba yod pa'i shlo ka gcig yang 'di la ma dmigs zhes pa dang*/ yan lag drug cu zhes pa'i tshigs bcad 'thor bu gnyis/ mgon g.yag la bsngags pa mgor/ gang lus char sprin phung po ni// zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por glang po che la bsngags pa gsungs pa 'di nyid la yig skyon zhugs pa 'dra/

chang la bsngags pa'i rab tu byed pa bdud rtsi'i bum pa mgor khro bo'i rgyal po bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sa yi snying po 'gro ba'i nyer 'tsho dang*/ zhes yod pa/ mchod 'os la bsngags pa mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang las sangs rgyas chos tshogs zhes yod pa/ lnga bsdus sgra gcan gza' lnga dang bcas pa'i rtsis gzhi rin po che'i 'od zer dri ma med pa mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs kyi padmor gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// srid dang mya ngan 'das pa'i gtso// zhes yod pa/ nyi khyim 'pho ba'i nges pa mgor/ gsal zhing thogs med myur du 'jug /ces yod pa/ dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i rtsis dus gsal ba'i sgron me mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ de'i don yang dag par bsdus pa mgor dpal dus kyi 'khor lo la phyag 'tshal lo// rab byung sogs bsdoms bcu gnyis zhes yod pa/ gdod ma'i dus gsal bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i rtsis mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ rtsis kyi gtsug lag dang mthun par nges pa zhes bya ba mgor 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od rab gsal zhing*// zhes yod pa/ dhrū ba gnyis pa'i rtsis mgor/ na mo gu ru ratna bhaṭṭā ra kā ya/ gang gi thugs rjes 'gro kun rab bzung nas// zhes yod pa/ lo bdag nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi rtsis mgor/ mkhyen pas shes bya kun gzigs nas// zhes yod pa/ rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba'i gtsug lag gi de kho na nyid rin po che'i sgron ma mgor tshig de nyid rgya skad dang bod skad du yod pa/ chos 'khor dus kyi bstan rtsis mgor sangs rgyas bltams pa'i dus la sogs nas zhes yod pa/ sangs rgyas kyi dus chen bzhi'i ngos 'dzin mgor thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dga' ldan nas zhes yod pa/ bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab 'gyur ro 'tshal

bzhengs pa po jim gyim yin bzhengs pa'i gsal byed sdeb sbyor gyi rgyan rnam par bkra ba mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ dam pa'i chos rin po che shin tu rgyas pa'i sde snod bzhengs pa'i tshul bstan pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por jim gyim gsungs pa 'di yin/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po gnyis kar gnyis yod gsungs kyang gcig las dpe ma rnyed/ maṅgal yab yum gyis rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dang phal po che bzhengs pa la bsngags pa mgor chos rin po che nye bar bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed kyi rab tu byed pa zhes yod pa/ ji big de mur gyis phal po che/ gser 'od dam pa/ stong phrag brgya pa rnams bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// thugs rje'i thugs ni kun nas rnam dag cing*// zhes yod pa/ rgyal po a rog ches 'bum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// srid zhi'i bde legs ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// zhes yod pa/ go pe las rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor gsung rab rin po che rnam par bkod pa'i mtshon byed ces yod pa/ dge 'dun bzang po sogs kyis yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ chos kyi dbyings las zhes yod pa/ rin chen dpal gyis 'bum bzhengs pa la bsngags pa mgor chos bzhengs pa'i mtshon byed nye bar bkod pa zhes yod pa/ zin shing gi ston pa bcu bdun yang dag pa'i rigs pas pham par byas te rab tu byung ba'i tshe sbyar ba'i tshigs bcad mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// yod dang med pa la sogs pa// zhes yod pa/ theg pa chen po'i slob dpon dang slob mas lam nyams su blang ba'i tshul gyi rnam dbye bstan pa mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gtsang mkhas rab brtan byams par ldan// zhes yod pa/

chos rje pa bde bar gshegs dus dbus gtsang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams la spring ba mgor/ dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// zhes yod pa/ khro bu lo tsā ba la bskur ba dang gdams pa gnyis mgor/ dpal ldan nyin mor byed pa'i gzi ldan zhing*// zhes pa dang*/ mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor legs bshad 'od zer gyis// zhes yod pa/ las chog rgyas bsdus gnyis kyi mgor thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhan po dang slob dpon dang dge 'dun rnams zhes yod pa/ bsnyen gnas kyi cho ga mgor bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa 'bogs pa'i tshul ni zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por 'di gsal kha med kyang phyi mo thams cad na gong gi las chog dang 'brel nas 'dug pas lung rgyun yod pa 'dra/ rgyal po yab sras kyis mchod rten bzhengs pa la bsngags pa'i sdeb sbyor daṇḍa ka mgor na mo gu ru ratna tra yā ya/ dpal dang ldan zhing zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por rgyal bu jim gyim sogs la bsngags pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ bsngags par 'os pa'i rab tu byed pa mgor tshig de nyid yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por hor gyi rgyal rabs lnga pa rgyal po go pe la bsngags par gsungs pa 'di yin/ bod kyi rgyal rabs la bsngags pa'i tshigs bcad mgor gang gi srid gsum rgya mtsho'i zhes yod pa/ gsan yig dbang gi rgyal por jim gyim la bstod pa gsungs pa 'di yin/ bod kyi rgyal rabs mgor/ srong btsan sgam po me mo glang la 'khrungs// zhes yod pa/ lung dang brgyud pa sna tshogs kyi gsan yig mgor/ oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ rdo rje 'chang zhes yod pa/ slob dpon bsod nams seng ge'i spyan sngar phrin du zhu ba mgor bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi zhes yod pa/ grags pa rin chen gyi zhus lan mgor dpal mchog bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sde snod 'dzin pa grags pa rin chen gyis// zhes yod pa/

rgyal bu byang chub sems dpa' khyu mchog skyong la bka' bsgo gnang ba mgor bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma dam pa brgyud pa dang zhes yod pa/ gur mgon gyi rjes gnang mgor bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// thog ma kho nar mkha' 'gro dang chos skyong zhes yod pa/ rgyal po go pe la sras dang btsun mor bcas pa la bde legs su bya ba'i bkra shis kyi tshigs su bcad pa/ shing yos dpal ldan ma/ me 'brug bsod nams ma/ me sbrul dpal 'byung ma/ sa rta bkra shis ma/ 'dir lug sprel gnyis la mi snang*/ lcags bya tshe dang ye shes ma// chu khyi 'gro ba ma/ chu phag bde legs ma/ shing byi gang mnyes ma/ shing glang byang sems ma/ me stag he ru ka dpal ma/ me yos rgyal mtshan rtse mo/ sa 'brug ji snyed ma/ sa sbrul rgyal ba ma/ lcags rta bkra shis ma/ lcags lug chos nyid ma/ chu sprel skyob pa ma/ chu bya dngos grub ma/ shing khyi sa dbang ma/ shing phag bla med ma/ me byi dngos grub ma/ me glang don grub ma/ sa stag gang la bkra shis ma/ sa yos gang drin ma/ lcags 'brug thub dbang chos rgyal ma rnams te lo gsar gyi tshe gnang ba'i bkra shis nyer gsum mo// yang dpal ldan khyed sku lhun po ltar brtan zhing*// zhes bya ba'i bkra shis shlo ka gcig rnams bzhugs so// //'di dag gi go rim bsgrigs pa'i gzhi ni ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gsan yig rgya mtsho dang*/ glo bo smon thang gi rgyal pos gong ma yab sras gsum gyi bka' 'bum bzhengs pa'i dkar chag rdo rje 'chang gis mdzad pa dang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig thub bstan rgyas pa'i nyin byed dang*/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i gsan yig dbang gi rgyal po rnams la zhib tu gtugs tshe/ snga phyi'i go rim 'dra min dang chos tshan mang nyung sogs kyi khyad par 'ga' re mchis kyang*/ 'dir sngon gyi bka' 'bum phal cher dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig dang mthun shas che ba byung bas 'ga' zhig de nyid gzhir gzhag

da lta'i lung rgyun dpal mchog nas sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas gsan pa 'di nyid khyab che ba snang yang*/ dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i de dang snga phyi'i go rim dang chos tshan mang nyung dang*/ bstan bcos kyi ming gzung yang 'ga' zhig gzhung tshig dang*/ 'ga' zhig kha byang las dras nas btags pa sogs kyis las dang po pas ngos zin dka' bar 'dug kyang*/ 'dir gong 'og thams cad kyi khyad par ngos gzung sla ba'i ched du ngor chen rdo rje 'chang la sogs pa'i bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsan yig thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsdoms nas sgo khyim la aṃ gi dgu pa'i mtshan ma yod pa rnams ded pas ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi gdan sa dgu pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas gsan ltar rtogs pa dang*/ aṃ gi nyer bzhi pa'i mtshan ma yod pa rnams ded pas gdan sa nyer bzhi pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs pas gsan ltar rtogs par 'gyur la/ gzhan paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan sogs kyis gsan pa'i lung rgyun ni brgyud pa'i kha skong ma gtogs pa yan chad dkon mchog lhun grub pa'i gsan yig ji lta ba bzhin yin no// rtags gang yang med pa rnams ni gsan yig na med kyang*/ glegs bam gyi grags su sngar yod pa dang phyis rnyed pa gsar 'dzud zhus pa rnams yin pas/ slar 'di dag gi lung rgyun brgyud pa yid ches pa las btsal te rgya cher spel dgos so zhes pa'i don yin no// smras pa/ rgyas bshad dkar chag ngos su phra zhib chos// gtan la 'bebs nus rig pa bdag med rdzun// yang na shes rab rang rtsal ma 'gags gdangs// shes bya'i gnas la chags bral tsam zhig nges// gsung rab dad pa'i me lces yid kyi chu// bskol ba'i shugs kyis ming tshig yi ge'i tshogs// 'dus pa'i dpa' rlabs lang ling 'phyur ba'i rtser// dka' gnas lbu dkar 'dzum pa'i ltad mo byung*// 'di mthong rgyus med mgo bo mgor byed pa'i// rmongs pa skyengs te ma bzod 'dres che ba'i// grogs 'dis da nas bdag cag spangs so zhes// skyo ba'i zol gyis yul gzhan 'khyams pa bzhin// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o//

//gsum pa brgyud pa'i ngos gzung gi sgo nas mjug bsdus ba la gnyis kyi dang po gong ma yab sras gsum pa'i gsung rab rnams kyi lung dang glegs bam dang po nas phyogs gcig tu bsdebs pa ma byung ba la/ dus phyis bla ma dpal ldan seng ge'i thugs dgongs rdzogs pa'i phyir du chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa'i bkas bskul te/ mkhan po shes rab rdo rje dang*/ dbus pa rin rgyal gnyis phyogs kun tu btang ste/ lung su yod las zhus shing dpe rnams phyogs gcig bsdebs pas na/ lung thams cad phyogs gcig nas brgyud pa med mod/ 'on kyang mkhan po shes rab rdo rjes bla ma so so las gsan pa'i brgyud pa ni lam 'bras sogs lam skor dgu/ lam gces bsdus dang bcas pa'i brgyud pa ni rje sa chen/ bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'phags pa/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ des sher rdor la'o// yang na 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa la'o// yang na chos rje sa paṇḍi ta/ tshogs sgom pa/ nyan chen pa/ brag phug pa/ dpal ldan seng ge de gnyis las chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pas gsan no// 'on kyang gsung ngag rin po che'i skor rnams nyams khrid ma gtogs/ bklag lung byed pa'i srol med do zhes ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gis gsan yig rgya mtsho las gsungs/ rgyud sde spyi'i stong thun/ dag ldan/ mngon rtogs ljon shing*/ gur gyi sa bcad/ gur rgyan rnams sa chen/ slob dpon rin po che/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan seng ge chos rje bla ma dam pa/ sher rdor ro// nag po pa'i dkyil chog de'i ṭī ka nā ro mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ me tī mkha' spyod kyi sgrub thabs/ rdzogs rim rtsa dbu ma/ lam gyi yan lag pra phab pa/ gnod sbyin mo'i sgrub thabs/

tshangs pa'i bu mo'i sgrub pa/ padma pa ti'i man ngag khol po pa ti'i man ngag sman chen po'i bcud len/ me trī mkha' spyod kyi rjes gnang rnams brag phug pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan pa/ sher rdor ro// sgrol ma spyi sgrub/ so so'i sgrub thabs/ bstod pa 'don thabs/ nyi sbas pas mdzad pa'i phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sgrub thabs las tshogs dang bcas pa'i ṭī ka sa chen gyis mdzad pa'i lha bcu bdun ma'i dkyil chog rnams rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ chos rje bsod nams pa/ sher rdor ro// sgrol ma'i bstod sgrub gnyis kyi brgyud pa ni/ nyi sbas/ ti lo/ nā ro/ nag po pa/ gu rub lo tsā ba/ rong pa/ brang ti dar ma snying po/ bla ma sa chen/ mchims khu dbon gnyis/ bla ma 'jam gsar/ lce mdo seng*/ bla ma rga lo/ rong pa sher seng*/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa man chad gong dang 'dra/ dkyil chog gi brgyud pa ni/ sgrol ma/ klu sgrub/ nyi ma sbas pa/ sla na shrī/ mañdzu shrī/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen pa/ mchims chos seng*/ mchims blo brtan/ bla ma 'jam gsar/ sri'u/ rje btsun rga lo/ sher seng*/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa man chad sngar dang 'dra/ sgrol ma maṇḍal bzhi ma'i brgyud pa ni/ mkhan po shes rab rgyal mtshan/ grub pa dpal bzang po/ bla ma bzang po pa/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan man gong dang 'dra/ rnam 'joms bya ba bsrung dang bcas pa/ dpal ldan pa/ chos rje bsod nams pa man 'dra'o// sa chen pa'i rgyud sde spyi'i rnam gzhag brtag gnyis kyis bcad/ ṭī ka bde mchog rtsa rgyud kyi le 'brel/ sa bcad/ mal lo'i gsung la zin bris byas pa'i ṭī ka che ba/ 'jigs byed rtog bdun gyi ṭī ka che ba rnams bla ma sa chen/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa so ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa rin rgyal/ bla ma ye shes dpal/ sher rdor ro// rje btsun rtse mo'i saṃ pu ṭa'i ṭī ka rje btsun pa'i rab gnas don gsal/ he ru ka'i chas drug

gtor ma brgya rtsa rnams bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ zhang mdo sde dpal/ 'jam skya/ dpal ldan pa/ sher rdor ro// sgrol ma zhi khro'i sgrub thabs ni/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ shar pa sher 'byung*/ ye shes 'byung gnas rgyal mtshan/ dkon mchog 'byung gnas/ bde ba can pa ye shes mgon/ seng ge rgyal mtshan/ sher rdor ro// rje btsun rtse mo'i mi g.yo ba'i chu bsrung ni/ rje btsun sku mched/ chos rje pa/ mdo sde dpal/ lo mchog bag ston/ sher rdor ro// ku ru kulle'i sgrub thabs ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ 'u yug pa bsod seng*/ sru lung pa kun smon/ la ru pa yon tan dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bag ston/ shar rdor ro// gnyan gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa ni/ rje btsun chen po/ paṇa chen pa/ shar pa sku mched/ 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bag ston man 'dra'o// dur khrod bdag po'i sgrub thabs ni/ byang chen pa/ bag ston man 'dra'o// ma rgyud kye'i rdo rje'i sbyor drug yang*/ gzhon tshul man chad 'dra'o// rdo rje 'byung ba'i ṭī ka ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje khu dbon/ sru lung pa kun smon/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ slob dpon rin chen dpal/ bla ma rgyal ba dpal/ bla ma thogs med pa/ sher rdor ro// don zhags kyi lo rgyus/ sa bcad rgyud chung gi ṭī ka lag tu blang ba'i rim pa rnams rje btsun pa/ chos rje paṇa chen pa/ gtsang so zhor ba/ la ru pa/ grags chen pa/ 'phags 'od/ bu ston rin po che/ mkhan chen dwangs ma pa/ sher rdor ro// dril bu pa'i dbang chu/ sgrub thabs gnyis/ paṇa chen pa man gzhan dang 'dra zhing*/ des bo dong rin po che/ khro phu rin po che/ yang rtse ba rin chen seng ge kun mkhyen rin chen grub/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa man sngar bzhin no// sdom pa nyi shu pa'i ṭī ka mtshan brjod 'don thabs rnams rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ mkhan chen byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi grags gzhon/
