rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ mkhan chen gzhon nu mgon/ sher rdor ro// kye'i rdo rje'i dbang chu chen mo/ dbang chog nas gling ma/ chos la 'jug pa'i sgo/ byis pa bde blag tu 'jug pa dang*/ mngon rtogs yan lag drug pa/ bdag med mngon rtogs/ lū hi pa'i mngon rtogs gsum/ phag mo zhal gnyis ma'i sgrub thabs/ sngags kyi byin rlabs/ las bcu/ mchims chos seng la spring yig gzhan phan nyer mkho/ arga'i cho ga kha 'bar ma'i gtor chen rnams paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ 'jam rgyal/ bla ma a mo gha/ sher rdor ro// dril bu pa'i lo rgyus/ rim lnga/ tshes bcu'i mchod pa/ nges brjod bla ma'i 'khrul 'khor bri thabs rnams stod lo// slob dpon a mo gha/ sher rdor ro/ sgrol ma phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gi sa bcad/ ṭī ka nyi ma sbas pa'i nyer gcig ma'i las tshogs dang sa gcod rnams rje btsun pa/ bla ma thub pa mgon/ a mo gha/ sher rdor ro// rigs gsum spyi'i rigs gtad/ a ra pa tsa na'i mngon rtogs/ dkyil chog rnams kyang gong dang 'dra'o// dpa' bo grub pa'i rgyud kyi ṭī ka ni/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ shong pa bsod rin/ slob dpon gzungs 'dus/ rin po che bsod nams dbang phyug sher rdor ro// brtag gnyis kyi ṭī ka rnam bshad nyi ma'i 'od zer/ chos rje khu dbon/ de gnyis ka las shong pa bsod rin/ sras kun rin/ sher rdor ro// rab gnas bzang po drug dus tha ma'i cho ga bstod pa daṇḍa ka kye rdor dkyil 'khor gyi bkra shis rnams 'phags pa rin po che/ cog ro ston gzhon/ chos brtson/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sher rdor ro// 'dod rgyal dmar po'i sgrub thabs/ rdo rje myu gus mdzad pa'i ṭī ka sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen/ khams pa dbon po/ rje btsun rga lo/ ā ka ra/ sangs rgyas rin chen/ sher rdor ro// tshogs bdag gi sgrub thabs che chung*/ rje btsun pa/ paṇa chen pa/ skyob pa dpal/ gzhon nu bkra shis/

rdo rje dpal/ gu rub sher rin/ sangs rgyas rin chen man 'dra'o// kye'i rdo rje'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa chos rje bsod rgyal/ sher rdor ro// glu'i bshad pa la sogs pa mngon rtogs/ bstod pa la sogs pa drug cu rtsa dgu'i brgyud pa/ sa chen pa yab sras gsum/ chos rje paṇa chen pa/ dmar chos rgyal/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/ bka' bcu pa gzhon nu seng ge sher rdor ro// gnyen gyi sgrol ma yan lag drug pa'i brgyud lugs gcig ni/ klu sgrub nas/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ mar me mdzad bzang po/ dpal bde ba/ bi ma la gupta/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma/ gnyen lo tsā ba/ gnang kha'u pa/ rje sa chen/ rje btsun pa/ chos rje pa/ byang chub dpal/ bde ba dpal/ bka' bzhi pa grags pa gzhon nu/ rin chen bsod nams grags pa/ rin chen grags tshul ba/ de las mkhan po shes rab rdo rjes zhus so// de nas mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge thams cad mkhyen pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ dpal sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mtshungs med nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ rin po che dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ de nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs la'o// yang na yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar pa man 'dra/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub/ dkon mchog dpal ldan/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis man 'dra'o// //gnyis pa chos rje khu dbon gnyis las/ dang po sa skya paṇḍi ta'i bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa ni/ sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/

slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ chos rje byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab dam pa kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ rje shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ de nas mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs la'o// yang na 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// yang na dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// //gnyis pa 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che'i bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon 'dul 'dzin/ chos rje byang seng ba/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ sa skya pa 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang*/ byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ rje btsun nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ thams cad mkhyen pa dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ yang na dkon mchog lhun grub nas/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ nam mkha' dpal bzang man 'dra'o// yang bka' 'bum gyi brgyud pa lugs gcig ni/ 'phags pa rin po che/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ dga' ldan pa kun bsod/ bla ma dpal ldan seng ge bla ma don yod rgyal mtshan man 'dra'o// yang na dkon mchog 'phel/ rje lha mchog seng ge dkon mchog lhun grub man 'dra'o// //smras pa/ skal dman lha min myang khom ma byung ba'i// bka' sol bdud rtsi mkhas mang sngon gyi lhas// blangs te bshad sgrub snyim pas spel ba'i rgyun// de 'dzin lha rnams thar pa'i bcud ldan 'gyur// yid la thar pa 'dod kyang thob byed chos// ma shes zog po'i ngag sgros bsgugs pa'i tshe// bden gnyis zung 'jug bstan pa'i lam 'di dang*// ston byed bla ma phrad rnams a re 'tsheng*// tshe 'di'i dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu zhig

/dbul pos rnyed la dga' spro byed na deng*// tshe rabs gtan gyi dgos 'dod sgrub pa'i thabs// 'di la dga' dang gus pa su mi byed// dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che'i par gyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i dkar chag 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ 'jug pa bde ba'i ched du brtsams pa'i bstan bcos ngos gzung ba'i skabs te gnyis pa'o// //spyi don gsum pa bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du chos sbyin par du bsgrub tshul la gsum ste/ par du bskul ba'i gang zag par du sgrub pa'i sbyin bdag sgrub pa'i grogs dang gnas dus so// dang po ni/ de ltar dpal sa skya'i rje btsun grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po rnam pa lnga'i gsung rab rin po che 'di rnams ni/ dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bgrod par bya ba'i 'jug ngogs/ mdo rgyud bstan bcos thams cad kyi dgongs don ma lus pa gsal bar byed pa'i sgron me/ log par rtog pa'i grub mtha' ngan pa'i ri bo rnam par 'joms pa'i rdo rje/ blo dang ldan pa rnams gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu sgrol bar byed pa'i ded dpon/ mi gnas mya ngan las 'das pa'i grong khyer du 'jug pa rnams kyi them skas/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro rdo rje bdag med ma dang*/ dpal ldan bi rū pa la sogs pa grub pa'i 'khor los sgyur ba brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i thugs bcud/ chos bdag mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams kyis padma'i dri la bung ba 'khor ba bzhin du bsrungs pa'i zab chos 'di rnams shin tu gnyen pas mang du spel ba lta zhog snod dang mi ldan pa rnams la dam du sba zhing gsang dgos pa yin na'ang*/ sde snod gsum dang rgyud sde zab mo dgongs 'grel bcas pa'i 'gyur ro 'tshal rnams nyan pa dang bshad pa dang sgom pas nyams su len pa la sogs pa'i tshe na/ lung dang rigs pa dang rjes su gdams pa ste/ mtshan nyid gsum mam gnyis gang rung dang ldan pa dang*/

de rnams kyi nang nas kyang yid ches pa'i lung dang brgyud pa khungs thub las 'ongs pa'i gdams pa gtso che ste/ shin tu lkog gyur la spyod pa la lung nyid tshad ma yin pa'i phyir dang*/ lung don man ngag brgyud pa'i ngag 'gros kyis ma brgyan na/ lam gang la'ang bde bar nyams su mi len pa du ma yod pa'i phyir dang*/ lung tshig la yang ji bzhin min pa sogs la sgra ji bzhin pa sogs su mngon par zhen nas 'khrul pa'ang mang po yod de/ zla grags kyis/ mtha' drug bral bas nges par rtogs zhes gang smras pa/ zla ba lta 'dod sor mo'i rtse la blta dang mtshungs// zhes gsungs pas so// de bas na rgyal ba'i dgongs don mtha' drug tshul bzhi la sogs pa'i don gtan la phab ste/ gsal bar ston pa'i bstan bcos chen po 'di lta bu la yun ring du sbyangs shing khong du chud par ma byas na/ gang zag phal cher gyis 'bad pa don du mi 'gyur ba'ang mang du yod pas na de dag la phan pa'i phyir dang*/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i ring lugs dri ma med pa 'di nyid kyi rjes su 'jug pa'i slob gra'i skye bo blo gsal zhing don du nyer ba rnams kyang mdo smad kyi phyogs 'dir bka' 'bum gyi dpe gras dkon pa'i dbang gis nyan bshad kyi rgyun dang*/ klog 'dzin byed pa'i srol sogs nyag phrar song ba de dag la'ang phan pa'i phyir dang*/ deng gi dus kyi 'gro ba skal pa dman pa rnams ni bstan pa rnam dag gi rjes su 'jug pa ches dkon zhing*/ zhugs par rlom pa rnams kyang sde snod dang rgyud sde dang de dag gi dgongs 'grel tshad ldan rnams tshig gi na ya tsam yin par bsams nas rna bas thos pa tsam yang don du mi gnyer bar/ de dag gi dgongs pa mi shes pa'i gang zag spyi brtol can rnams kyis lung rigs gang la'ang ma 'brel ba'i rang bzo'i tshig gang dran smras pa'i rjes su 'jug cing*/ nyan bshad sgom gsum yang de lta bu la byed pa mang zhing*/

rmongs dad can gyi snying med rnams kyang smig rgyu'i chu la ri dwags sred pa ltar de dag gi rjes su 'jug pa'i 'jig rten rmongs pa de dag dngos dang brgyud nas mi bslu nges pa'i lam yang dag pa dang phrad par gyur na ci ma rung snyam pa'i bcos ma ma yin pa'i lhag bsam dkar pos rgyal bas lung bstan pa'i rgyal tshab chen po/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po zhes yongs su grags pa'i gdugs dkar gyi grib mar/ lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba ma lus pa'i ngal bso'i gnas su gyur pa/ gong de'i rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las dkar po'i khur gyis rnam par lci ba'i gdan sa sum cu pa/ dge slong bkraṃ shiṃs lhunaṃ grubaṃ ces 'bod pa'i ngag nas/ rje btsun gong ma'i gsung rab 'di rnams zab pa dang rgya che ba'i chos kyi 'byung gnas/ gzhung mang po la sbyang ba dang*/ lam yang dag pa don du gnyer ba rnams la med thabs med pa'i chos yin pas/ bar du bsgrubs na legs tshul gyi bskul ba'i tshig dga' thal lo// smras pa/ dad pa g.yon can grogs kyis don med btang*// chos dang chos min dpyod pa'i blo nus bral// gti mug chad stong mtha' las grol dus med// rmongs chen skye bo skal med snying re rje// de tshe bkra shis dge 'byung e waṃ ba'i// lhun grub rgyun mi 'chad pa'i phrin las kyi// rjes 'jug bdag gis bstan dang lus can la// phan re'i lhag bsam tshig gis 'di skad bskul// dgos don zab rgyas 'jam dbyangs rnam lnga'i gsung*// par du bskrun na dga' ba'i zhu gsol gdangs// rab snyan 'ga' zhig sa spyod mchog gi yid// 'phrog 'dod mgrin par yibs te gnas pa bzhin// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gnyis pa par du sgrub pa'i sbyin bdag ni// sngon dus 'gro mgon 'phags pa dang se chen gan mchod yon nas bzung*/ da lta'i gong ma chen po 'di nyid bcas kyi las lung gi bka' tham chen mo rnams sngon gyi yab mes stong dpon zla ba bzang po nas bzung ste chos rgyal chen po 'di nyid kyi bar du rim pas phebs shing*/

sde bzhi dang dge bcu'i 'bras bu phun sum tshogs pas mngon par mtho ba'i chab srid tha gru yangs po la dbang sgyur ba'i gdan sa pa/ chos dang srid kyi mkhyen dpyod mda' gzhu'i 'khrul 'khor bskyod pa tsam gyis/ chos min spyod pa dang chab srid la rnam par 'tshe ba'i phyogs kyi dgra sde mgrin pa bcu pa'i mgo bo bregs te/ bod chen yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gyi yid 'phrog si tā/ dpal 'byor mdzes pa'i rgyan dang bcas pa/ las dbang stobs kyi grogs po ha nu manda'i rtsal gyis blangs te/ rang dbang du sgyur ba'i chos rgyal dga' byed chen po ste/ mtshan dngos bstan pa tshe ring zhes yul gru chen po kun na yongs su grags pa/ gong de'i zhabs stegs nor bu brtsegs pa'i ba gam mthon por rin chen gdub sil mdzes pa'i zhabs zung rnam par 'god tshe/ bod chen ljongs kyi rgyal blon 'bangs dang bcas pa phal mo che'i gtsug gis gus pas 'dud kyang khengs pa mi mnga' zhing*/ thugs rgyud byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems la 'byongs pas sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa ltar brtse zhing*/ khyad par mgon med dang phongs pa dang nad pa sogs ni gang la gang 'os kyi dngos pos bskyang ba dang*/ 'chi nges pa'i sems can mang po'i srog bsrung ba sogs dge ba bcu dang rjes su mthun pa'i bka' khrims kyis mnga' 'bangs thams cad rdzogs ldan dus kyi bde skyid gsar pa'i dga' ston la 'god cing*/ bstan pa spyi dang bye brag rje sa skya pa dang ngor chen rdo rje 'chang yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i bstan pa bla nas blar 'degs pa'i snying stobs gzhan las khyad par 'phags shing*/ slar yang de nyid rnam par dkar pa'i bgyi ba gsum gyi sgo nas zhing 'dis gtsos pa'i yul phyogs thams cad du dar zhing rgyas pa'i ched dang*/ rang nyid kyi'ang bla'i mchod gnas kyi ched du dmigs te/ dpal e waṃ chos ldan la sogs pa'i gdan sa chen po rnams na bzhugs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa rnams spyan drangs te/

don yod rnam pa bzhis mnyes par mdzad cing*/ de dag las 'ongs pa'i thugs bcud rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin zab mo'i bsgom bzlas kyis nyin mtshan khor yug 'da' ba dang*/ bka' 'gyur ro cog baiḍūrya'i mthing shun la rin po ches tshar mang du bzhengs shing*/ slar yang chos sbyin par du bsgrubs pas gtsos pa'i bde bar gshegs pa'i rten gsum bzhengs pa dang*/ mchod pa'i yo byad bskrun pa sogs rnam par dkar ba'i mdzad spyod gtam du glengs na 'jig rten mes po yang ngal snyam byed pa kho na yin zhing*/ de lta bu'i chos rgyal chen po de nyid kyi snyan dbang rin po cher par du bsgrub pa'i zhu gsol phul lo// de nyid gsan pa'i mod la thugs dges pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma dang bcas te/ bzhed don ji lta ba bzhin du bsgrub bo zhes zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bka' gsal snyan pos gandha rba'i gling bu'i khengs pa yang 'phrog snyam byed par gyur to// smras pa/ de thos sa skyong bzhin las sngon med 'dzum// bstan te bzhed don bsgrub par zhal bzhes tshe// ring gnas mkhas mang rnam shes rna ba'i sgor// dbang med rgyug ste mnyan pa yin nam snyam// chos mthun ya rabs rnams ni ma bskul yang*// rtag tu dge ba'i phyogs la brtson bgyid na// chos smra'i ngag gi dge bskul phan yon can// dka' yang sgrub pa rang gi chos nyid yin// bar skabs kyi tshigs su bcad pa'o// //gsum pa sgrub pa'i grogs dang gnas dus ni/ de lta bu'i sa spyod bstan pa'i sbyin bdag chen pos chos sbyin par du bsgrub pa'i nyer bsdogs kyi bka' lung rnams ji skad stsal ba bzhin du sngon gyi las dbang rkang mgyogs kyi pho nyas ring par bos te/ lugs gnyis kyi bgyi ba kun la dbang sgyur ba'i dpa' mdzangs 'phrul lon chen po rnams kyi nang nas bslab ston pa/ sngon bsags bsod nams kyi ri dbang brtan pos sa la spyod pa'i bstan srid lha dbang gi grong khyer mthon por 'degs la ngal ba med cing*/

chos dang srid kyi mkhyen dpyod nyi zla'i 'od snang ring por 'phro ba'i gnyer pa a srung gtso bor bskos/ las gnyer rnams kyi mgo 'dzin dang khur len gyi grogs ldan pa/ mkhyen dpyod kyi me long gtsang mar shes bya'i gzugs brnyan 'gog med du 'char ba'i drung yig tshe ring 'phel dang*/ phyag mdzod gu ru bkra shis gnyis la gnang nas/ de dag gi par bkram sdud sogs kyi grogs ldan pa brda dang yig rtsis la rnam par dpyod pa'i blo mig gsal ba par dpon gzungs skyabs bcas te/ zhu dag gi phyi mo rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin dam pa mang po byon pa'i gdan sa/ skyor mda' bsam gling nas bka' 'bum shin tu dag pa cha gcig rga nas a gnyan dam pa'i thugs dam rten du bzhengs pa'i chos rje khu dbon gyi bka' 'bum gser dngul las grub cing*/ bzo rgyu khyad du 'phags pa'i chos chen glegs bam drug rong ston shes bya kun rig dang*/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang gi dngos slob bka' rab 'byams smra ba'i dbang po ā nanda dzñā na'i thugs dam rten gdan sa thar lam dgon nas dpe khungs thub cha gcig gdan sa chen po 'di nyid na sngar gong ma rnams kyis bzhengs pa dang*/ phyis chos rgyal rang nyid kyi thugs dam rten du gsar bzhengs mdzad pa bcas shin tu legs pa cha gnyis/ gzhan yang lcags ra bsam 'grub rtse dang*/ gling nas spyan drangs pa'i cha gnyis/ 'thor bu la mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs pa'i phyag dpe dngos ma 'ga' re dang bcas te/ bka' 'bum yongs rdzogs tshar drug tsam dang bstun nas/ dag byed gtso bo rang gi nye ba 'khor sgra dang snyan dngags sogs tha snyad rig pa'i gnas la byang chub pa/ dge slong tshul khrims rin chen dang*/ gzhan yang gsar rnying brda'i khyad la mkhas pa rmugs sangs pa sbyin pa rgya mtsho dang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan sogs bzhi tsam gyis zhus dag nan tan bgyis shing*/ rdo rje'i tshig gi dka' 'grel 'ga' zhig la phyi mo rnams mi mthun pa'i dogs gnas cung zad byung ba rnams kyang bka' dang bstan bcos gang yin gyi rtsa ba la gtugs te de dang mthun gang che'i dbang du btang*/

de dag tu'ang med pa'i 'dra min 'ga' re byung 'dug pa rnams ni bdag gis kyang dpyad pa'i grogs byas shing yid la nges pa rnams bcos/ ma nges pa rnams sor bzhag la rtags dang mchan bu yod par bgyis nas dpyad rung bzhag ste/ mdor na yid ches byar rung ba'i zhus dag nan chen bgyis/ 'phrul gyi yig gzugs la mkhas pa mang po'i nang nas bkrabs pa bcu drug dang*/ par brkos mkhas pa brgya lnga bcu tsam 'doms te/ de rnams la yon dbul rta nor/ ja dang ras/ du ba sogs gang mos byin pa nas kyi rtsis la/ zhus dag pa mi re la nyin re nas 'dong bcu gcig dbu lha'i brkos pa brnyan re la nas khal gcig dang zho gnyis/ bris par bshog ldebs re la nas 'dong bco lnga/ 'bring nas 'dong phyed dang bco lnga/ tha ma 'dong bcu bzhi/ brkos pa rab bar ldebs re la khal gnyis zho gnyis/ 'bring stod khal gnyis dang zho gcig 'dong lnga/ 'bring khal gnyis zho gcig tha ma khal gnyis/ thig 'debs pa dang shog mkhan gnyis la nyin rer 'dong bzhi re/ shing gzhog mkhan shing shar bdun la zho gcig shing rin shing shar bco lnga re la bar khag brtsis te thams cad khyon bsdoms pa ja la dril na 'khor drug stong phrag gcig dang bcu gsum gyis chos sbyin par du bsgrubs te/ de'ang bsgrub pa'i gnas ni dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mngon par byang chub pa'i gnas/ rdo rje'i gdan nas byang phyogs su dpag tshad brgya bgrod pa na/ rigs gsum mgon gyi rnam par 'phrul pa'i 'od gsal 'khon gyi gdung sras mkhas shing grub pa'i skyes chen rgyun mi 'chad pa byon pa'i gdan sa chen po dpal sa skya zhes yongs su grags pa de nyid yod la/ de nas me mtshams su zhag gi phung po gsum tsam bgrod pa'i bod chen por grags pa'i sa'i cha/ sems can spyi mthun gyi dge ba spyad pa'i bdag po'i 'bras bu legs par smin pa'i sa phyogs gzi mdangs che zhing khod snyoms pa la/

khor yug kun nas ri bo'i tshogs rnams ni rang rang gi bkra shis pa'i rtags kyi dge mtshan tha dad pa bzung nas gcig la gcig ngom pa ltar 'khod cing*/ gangs ri dang brag ri dag ni ma bcos drang po'i cha lugs gcig pur 'dzin la/ gzhan rnams ni dus dus su rgyal mo bzhis bgos pa'i gos bzang re mos su gon pa/ de dag gi bar mtshams rnams su 'brog dgon pa dang*/ grong dang*/ grong khyer dang*/ ljongs dang*/ skyed mos tshal dang*/ 'bab chu la sogs pa bkod pa legs pas kun gyi yid 'phrog par nus pa'i rten de dag la brten pa'i mi dang dud 'gros bsdus pa'i 'gro ba dpag tu med pa rnams ni rang rang gi sngon las kyi bgo skal tha dad pa la spyod pas/ chos mdzad rnams kyi dge ba bsgrub 'dod dang*/ sdig pa spang 'dod kyi blo gong nas gong du spel ba'i snod bcud dge ba'i bshes su gyur pa de dag gis yongs su bskor ba'i yul gyi lte ba/ sngon grub pa'i dbang phyug thang stong rgyal po'i zhabs kyis legs par btab ste lhun grub steng zhes mtshan du gsol ba'i chos sde khyad par can de nyid du sde dge sa spyod kyi gdung rgyud rim pas byon pa rnams kyis sangs rgyas bstan pa'i lugs srol rgya chen btsugs shing*/ khyad par mkhas shing grub pa'i gtsug rgyan 'jam mgon dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son pa mkhas mchog bkra shis dpal ldan/ yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ mang du thos shing lung rigs smra ba'i dbang phyug mkhan chen bzang po rgyal mtshan/ rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag mkhyen yangs kun dga' chos 'phel la sogs pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen rim pas byon pa rnams kyis sum ldan rdo rje 'dzin pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho lta bu'i dbus su/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum gyi sgo nas bstan pa rgya cher spel ba'i gdan sa chen po de nyid kyi nang gses/

rnam 'dren bstan pa'i sri zhu ba chen po sde dge chos rgyal bzhugs pa'i rgyal khab kun las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po 'di nyid du/ dus ni ston pa shākya seng ge rnam byung sa 'brug la sku bltams nas lo sum stong dgu brgya dang zhe drug 'das shing*/ brgyad cu bzhes pa me phag la mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshul bstan/ de nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya bgrangs pa'i me yos la bod du gnyen po gsang ba babs te bstan pa'i dbu brnyes nas lo chig stong dang sum brgya re bdun brgal/ chu spre'u rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug dpal sa skya pa kun dga' snying po sku 'khrungs nas bgrang gzhi drug brgya zhe gnyis 'das pa saṃ skṛ ta'i skad du ā nanda/ de nyid bod skad du bsgyur tshe kun dga'/ ma hā tsi na'i yul gru chen por gye yin/ dbang thang dang bstun pa'i ming la shing stag du bod pa'i gsar tshes kyi gnam lo'i zla

4 tshes 25 dge ba la mgo tshugs/ de nas bzung ste shing yos khrums stod zla ba'i tshes bcu bzhi/ rje brtse ba chen po dang sa skya paṇa chen gnyis ka'i thugs chos dbyings zab mor mnyam par gzhag pa'i zla dus kyi mchod pa'i nyin yig mkhan rnams kyis mtha' rdzogs par bris zin cing*/ me pho 'brug gi gnam lo'i zla tshes bzang po la par gyi mtha' legs par grub nas bzhugs khri la mnga' gsol ba'i gsung rab rin chen dbang gi rgyal po 'di nyid lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten pa thams cad kyi gtsug tu rnam par rgyal nas phan pa dang bde ba'i 'dod dgu zad mi shes pa'i 'byung gnas dam par gyur cig/ //smras pa/ sa spyod bka' lung rin chen cod pan can// mkhyen dpyod lang tshos dregs pa'i chos blon dbur// bzhugs pa'i las byed blo gros ldan mthong tshe// ma bzod phur bu mtho ris bros kyi dogs// ma brdal khod snyoms gzhi la lag stabs stong*// bsgyur te ma bcos dbyibs legs ri bo'i phreng*// ma bskul dus kyi dga' mas rgyan 'bul tshe// ma bos kun yid 'gugs pa'i dge mtshan ngom// de dbus chos ldan rgyal pos bskyangs pa'i gnas// phyi nang nyer 'tshes dben zhing chos kyi sgra// lhun grub sa stengs grags pa'i rgyal khab nas// dus tshes dge bar chos sbyin che 'di spel// dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che'i par gyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i dkar chag 'phrul gyi lde mig las/ bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du chos sbyin par du bsgrub tshul gyi skabs te gsum pa'o// //'dir smras pa/ gangs can gdul bya bskal sngon yid can shes bya'i mkhar 'gro drang po'i bsam gtan bcud len tshe// rang dgar 'khyogs po'i blo can gyis btsal phyogs lhung bza' bas nyen pa phal cher dam chos kyi// 'od snang dang bral blang dor 'khrul pa'i mun par 'khyams rnams brtse ba'i skya rengs sngon 'gro ba'i// legs bshad nyi mas smra ngan mun bcom chos kyi lam ston 'jam dbyangs rnam lnga'i bka' drin bsam/

1 /tshul gnas dge ba'i bshes las thos na dad pa'i rtsa ba brtan pa'i rgyu// bsams na ma rtogs log rtog the tshom ring bral dga' ba'i yal 'dab bskyed// bsgoms na blo mchog gong nas gong 'phel sangs rgyas yon tan 'bras smin byed// bden gnyis don ston tshig sbyor bsdebs legs bka' srol dpag bsam ljon pa 'dis/ 2 /mdo rgyud mtha' dag gsal bas sgron me ste// dran dbang kun dga' bskyed phyir ltad mo'i mdzod// lung rigs 'gal 'brel 'char pas ā darsha// bde gshegs yongs kyis bgrod phyir ma nor lam/ 3 /gsung rab rin chen glegs bam bco lnga yi// chos sbyin par sgo grangs med dkar chag gi /mig 'phrul kuñdzi ka yis cig car du// phye dang bka' gnas ltad mo dus gcig byung*/ 4 /bzo mgar mkhas pa'i skye ba ma blangs shing*// bi shwa karma sa 'dir 'ongs min par// mig 'phrul byed 'di su zhes nyi zlas kyang*// gling bzhir rgyu ba'i zol gyis blta phyir lhags/ 5 /dad pas dam chos 'di klog lan re zung*// bgyis pa'i phan yon dpag yas thub dbang gi /zhal gyis 'ches na 'dzad med par gyi ma// 'di bsgrubs dge ba snga ma'i 'bum 'gyur can/ 6 /'dis mtshon dus gsum kun du rang gzhan gyi// sgo gsum rjes 'brel legs byas ji snyed kun// bdag yid pho nya dri yi gzhon pa la// bskyon te gcig tu bsdus shing bsdoms pa'i mthus/ 7 /gnas skabs mthar thug phan bde'i char rgyun gyi// 'byung gnas bde gshegs bstan pa'i dbyar skyes sprin// skye dgu'i las nyon gdung skyob grib bsil can// 'jig rten khams kyi mkha' khyab dkrigs gyur cig 8 /lung rtogs bstan pa'i mchog ni 'di'o zhes// yid ches lung gi dpang po dbang btsan tshogs// lhang lhang bsngags pa sa skya pa yi bstan// bskal pa ji srid yun 'tsho 'phel gyur cig 9 /chags sdang rgyud 'khrugs rtsub dang gtum pa 'gas// shu bus smod kyang thub pa'i tshangs dbyangs gdangs// snyan 'gyur drug cus rab bstod e waṃ pa'i// lugs bzang 'jig rten khams kun dar gyur cig

10 /sdom gsum rin chen khur pos mi ngal zhing*// bshad dang sgrub pa'i gom rlabs bsgyur mkhas pa'i// bstan 'dzin glang chen khyu mchog grangs med kyi// mdzad bzang gom rje sa stengs kun khyab shog 11 /sde bzhi'i 'bras bu phun tshogs dge bcu yi// khrims dang stobs kyi 'khor los sa chen khyon// spyod mdzad bstan pa'i sbyin bdag yab sras bcas// sku tshe mi shigs bskal pa'i ring 'tshor shog /gal te phyi nang 'gal rkyen rno gdug gi /tsher ma gzings pa'i nags tshal bdo gyur na// bstan srung mthu dpung dregs pa'i me bo ches// drag sbyor bsreg pa'i las la brtson gyur cig 13 /rig byed dpal mo 'dod rgyal tshogs kyi bdag /thugs rje dkyus ring spros pa'i zur mig gis// khams gsum 'gro ba'i mdza' bo khengs ldan tshogs// dpal 'byor skyes bzang bcas pa rang dbang stsol/ 14 /chos 'di'i do dam khur len las byed bcas// skye kun dal 'byor lus thob dam pa yis// rjes bzung rgyal ba'i bstan la thos bsam bsgom// mthar phyin rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub shog 15 /'khor ba'i thang du sdug bsngal brgya phrag gis// dub pa'i mkha' mnyam 'gro ba'i 'khyams po rnams// dkon mchog thugs rje'i rkang 'thung grib tu ngal// bso zhing dge bcu'i 'bras bzang spyod gyur cig 16 /bla med dkon mchog gsum por rtse gcig blos// skyabs song thugs rje byin rlabs nus pas gang*// bslus pa'i tshig tsam mi rnyed bden pa 'dis// bdag gis smon lam gang btab 'grub gyur cig 17 /de ltar dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che'i chos sbyin par gyi sgo 'phar 'byed pa'i dkar chag 'phrul gyi lde mig ces bya ba 'di ni/ bod chen ljongs kyi yangs pa'i sa stengs kun tu dge ba bcu dang rjes su mthun pa'i bka' khrims dang las dbang stobs kyi 'khor los dbang sgyur ba'i chos rgyal chen po nyid nas/
